EDCS-04001020.summary: A funerary epitaph with two individuals, Licceia Quirina Fausta and Lucius Appius Quirinus Saturninus, providing their ages and burial information, likely from the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-04001021.translation: Honorata, dutiful, lived for 90 years. Titus Appius Quirinus Saturninus lived for 65 years; they are buried here.
EDCS-04001021.summary: A funerary epitaph for Honorata and Titus Appius Quirinus Saturninus, recording their ages and burial, likely from the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-04001022.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Apronia Laeta, daughter of Caius Apronius Simplicis.
EDCS-04001022.summary: A funerary dedication to the spirits of the departed for Apronia Laeta, daughter of Caius Apronius Simplicis, likely from the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-04001023.translation: To the spirits of the departed. Gaius Apuleius Rogatus, son of Gaius, of the Voting Tribe Quirina, devoted, lived 64 years; he lies here.
EDCS-04001023.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Gaius Apuleius Rogatus, who lived 64 years, dated to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-04001024.translation: Apuleia Quarta, daughter of Publius, devoted, lived 15 years; she lies here.
EDCS-04001024.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Apuleia Quarta, who lived 15 years, dated to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-04001025.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Marcus Atelius Kampanus, of the Voting Tribe Quirina, devoted, lived 27 years; he lies here.
EDCS-04001025.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Marcus Atelius Kampanus, who lived 27 years, dated to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-04001026.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Claudia Victoria lived 80 years, devoted; her devoted husband lies here. Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Marcus Atelius Paetus lived 85 years; he lies here.
EDCS-04001026.summary: This inscription contains two funerary epitaphs, one for Claudia Victoria (80 years) and one for Marcus Atelius Paetus (85 years), dated to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-04001027.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Atelia Polla lived 11 years, devoted; she lies here.
EDCS-04001027.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Atelia Polla, who lived 11 years, dated to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-04001028.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Bellenia Tertia lived [---] years.
EDCS-04001028.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Bellenia Tertia, with an incomplete age, dated to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-04001029.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Marcus C. Rogatianus lived 59 years and 10 months.
EDCS-04001029.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Marcus C. Rogatianus, who lived 59 years and 10 months, dated to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-04001032.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Lucius Caecilius Castus, devoted, lived 55 years; he lies here. Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Claudia Victoria lived 20 years, devoted; she lies here.
EDCS-04001032.summary: This inscription contains two funerary epitaphs, one for Lucius Caecilius Castus (55 years) and one for Claudia Victoria (20 years), dated to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-04001033.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Aemilia Fortunata, devoted, lived 32 years; she lies here. Lucius Caecilius Crescens Flavianus, devoted, lived 90 years. Titinia Honorata, devoted, lived 70 years; they lie here.
EDCS-04001033.summary: This inscription contains three funerary epitaphs for Aemilia Fortunata (32 years), Lucius Caecilius Crescens Flavianus (90 years), and Titinia Honorata (70 years), dated to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-04001034.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Fabricia Marcella, devoted, lived 30 years; she lies here. Caecilius Esidorus, devoted, lived 71 years; he lies here. He lies here.
EDCS-04001034.summary: This inscription contains two funerary epitaphs, one for Fabricia Marcella (30 years) and one for Caecilius Esidorus (71 years), with a repeated phrase, dated to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-04001035.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Petronia Ianuaria, dutiful, lived 80 years; she is buried here. Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Lucius Caecilius Quirina Honoratus, dutiful, lived 75 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-04001035.summary: This is a funerary inscription recording the ages and burial places of Petronia Ianuaria and Lucius Caecilius Quirina Honoratus, likely from the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-04001036.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Flavia Honorata, dutiful, lived 60 years. Lucius Caecilius Honoratus Auzentius, dutiful, lived 65 years. Caecilius Honoratus Rogatianus, most dutiful father. Caecilia Ianuaria, dutiful, lived 30 years; they are buried here.
EDCS-04001036.summary: This funerary inscription commemorates Flavia Honorata, Lucius Caecilius Honoratus Auzentius, and Caecilia Ianuaria, detailing their ages and burial.

EDCS-04001038.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Flavia Marcia, daughter of Quintus, lived 81 years for herself and her husband; she is buried here. Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Lucius Caecilius Quirina Nundinarius, dutiful, lived 50 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-04001038.summary: A funerary inscription recording the burial and ages of Flavia Marcia and Lucius Caecilius Quirina Nundinarius, likely dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-04001039.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Claudia Secunda, dutiful, lived 35 years. Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Publius Caecilius Victor, dutiful, lived 70 years.
EDCS-04001039.summary: This funerary inscription records the ages of Claudia Secunda and Publius Caecilius Victor, indicating they are dedicated to the spirits of the departed.

EDCS-04001040.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Caecilia Alumna A Honor, dutiful, lived 2 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-04001040.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Caecilia Alumna A Honor, recording her age at death and burial.

EDCS-04001041.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Caecilia Crispina, lived 93 years; she is buried here. V.
EDCS-04001041.summary: A funerary inscription recording the age and burial of Caecilia Crispina.

EDCS-04001043.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Pompeius, dutiful, lived 50 years; he is buried here. Caecilia Fortunata and her heirs made this.
EDCS-04001043.summary: This funerary inscription records the burial and age of Pompeius, and notes that it was made by Caecilia Fortunata and her heirs.

EDCS-04001044.translation: He lived 70 years. Caecilia Peregrina, his wife, lived 50 years; she is buried here. His wife, dutiful, lived 55 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-04001044.summary: This funerary inscription records the ages and burials of a man and two wives, likely from the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-04001047.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Quintus Caelius Felix, dutiful, lived 50 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-04001047.summary: A funerary inscription recording the age and burial of Quintus Caelius Felix.

EDCS-04001048.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Caius Caelius Victor, son of Marcus, from Quirina, dutiful, lived 24 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-04001048.summary: This funerary inscription records the age, parentage, tribe, and burial of Caius Caelius Victor.

EDCS-04001049.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Caessonia Nativa, dutiful, lived 73 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-04001049.summary: A funerary inscription recording the death and burial of Caessonia Nativa.

EDCS-04001050.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Kalpurnius Donatus lived 50 years.
EDCS-04001050.summary: A funerary inscription recording the death of Kalpurnius Donatus.

EDCS-04001051.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Quintus Calpurnius Felix, dutiful, lived 27 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-04001051.summary: A funerary inscription recording the death and burial of Quintus Calpurnius Felix.

EDCS-04001052.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Calpurnius Iucundus, dutiful, lived 40 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-04001052.summary: A funerary inscription recording the death and burial of Calpurnius Iucundus.

EDCS-04001053.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Quintus Calpurnius Praesidius, dutiful, lived 10 years; Lucius Calpurnius Praesumptivus, dutiful, lived [years]; Calpurnius Crescens, dutiful, lived 25 years.
EDCS-04001053.summary: A funerary inscription recording the deaths of multiple members of the Calpurnius family, with one age incomplete.

EDCS-04001054.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Bennia Secunda, dutiful, lived 25 years; she is buried here. Sacred to the Divine Shades. Quintus Calpurnius Pudens, dutiful, lived 2 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-04001054.summary: A funerary inscription recording the deaths and burials of two individuals, Bennia Secunda and Quintus Calpurnius Pudens.

EDCS-04001055.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Lucius Calpurnius Quintillus lived 35 years.
EDCS-04001055.summary: A funerary inscription recording the death of Lucius Calpurnius Quintillus.

EDCS-04001056.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Aninia Sanamt, dutiful, lived 72 years. Quintus Calpurnius Saturninus Quirina, dutiful, lived 75 years.
EDCS-04001056.summary: A funerary inscription recording the deaths of Aninia Sanamt and Quintus Calpurnius Saturninus Quirina.

EDCS-04001057.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Calpurnia Faustina lived 80 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-04001057.summary: A funerary inscription recording the death and burial of Calpurnia Faustina.

EDCS-04001058.translation: Calpurnia Profutura Fortunata Maximiana, dutiful, lived 14 months.
EDCS-04001058.summary: A funerary inscription recording the death of Calpurnia Profutura Fortunata Maximiana.

EDCS-04001059.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Here lies Marcus Caninius Clodianus, dutiful, who lived 4 years. He lies here.
EDCS-04001059.summary: A funerary inscription recording the death of Marcus Caninius Clodianus, who died at the age of 4.

EDCS-04001060.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Lucius Caninius Tranquillus, dutiful, lived 16 years. Lucius Caninius Quirina Honoratus, dutiful, lived 20 years. Lucius Caninius Quirina Victor.
EDCS-04001060.summary: A funerary inscription commemorating at least three individuals from the Caninius family, detailing ages for two of them.

EDCS-04001061.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Lucius Scantius Faustus, son of Marcius Quirina, dutiful, lived 31 years. He lies here.
EDCS-04001061.summary: A funerary inscription for Lucius Scantius Faustus, who died at the age of 31.

EDCS-04001063.summary: A funerary inscription for Quirina Catulus, who died at the age of 11.

EDCS-04001064.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Iulia Secunda, dutiful, lived 51 years. She lies here. Sacred to the departed spirits. Publius Cestius Martialis, Quirina, dutiful, lived 65 years. He lies here.
EDCS-04001064.summary: A funerary inscription recording the deaths of Iulia Secunda (aged 51) and Publius Cestius Martialis (aged 65).

EDCS-04001065.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Licinia Matrona, dutiful, lived 55 years. Sacred to the departed spirits. Publius Cestius Sedatus, dutiful, lived 25 years. He lies here. Publius Cestius Marchianus, dutiful, lived 20 years. He lies here.
EDCS-04001065.summary: A funerary inscription for Licinia Matrona (aged 55) and at least two individuals named Publius Cestius, Sedatus (aged 25) and Marchianus (aged 20).

EDCS-04001066.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Cestia Namphame, dutiful, lived 70 years. Lollia Maiorica, dutiful, lived 20 years.
EDCS-04001066.summary: A funerary inscription recording the deaths of Cestia Namphame (aged 70) and Lollia Maiorica (aged 20).

EDCS-04001067.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Tiberius Claudius
EDCS-04001067.summary: A fragment of a funerary inscription mentioning Tiberius Claudius, with no further details.

EDCS-04001068.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Tiberius Claudius Maritus, dutiful, lived 25 years. Egnatia Quarta, dutiful, lived 85 years. They lie here.
EDCS-04001068.summary: A funerary inscription commemorating Tiberius Claudius Maritus (aged 25) and Egnatia Quarta (aged 85).

EDCS-04001069.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Tiberius Claudius Acutius, dutiful, lived 80 years. Caecilia Silvana, dutiful, lived 75 years. Claudius Maximianus, dutiful, lived 35 years. Claudius Rogatinus, dutiful, lived 20 years. Claudia Acuta, dutiful, lived 8 years.
EDCS-04001069.summary: A funerary inscription recording the deaths of Tiberius Claudius Acutius (aged 80), Caecilia Silvana (aged 75), Claudius Maximianus (aged 35), Claudius Rogatinus (aged 20), and Claudia Acuta (aged 8).

EDCS-04001070.translation: To the Divine Shades. Tiberius Claudius Amicus, dutiful, lived 80 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-04001070.summary: A tombstone recording the life and burial of Tiberius Claudius Amicus, dated by the style of the inscription to the early imperial period.

EDCS-04001071.translation: To the Divine Shades. Tiberius Claudius Amicus, dutiful son of Tiberius, of the Quirina tribe, lived 46 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-04001071.summary: A tombstone for Tiberius Claudius Amicus, son of Tiberius, of the Quirina tribe, indicating his lifespan and burial, likely from the 1st-2nd century CE.

EDCS-04001072.translation: To the Divine Shades. Claudia Augurina, dutiful, lived 95 years; she is buried here. Tiberius Claudius Kampanus, dutiful, lived...
EDCS-04001072.summary: A tombstone that records the death of Claudia Augurina and begins to record the death of Tiberius Claudius Kampanus, possibly a family burial, from the imperial period.

EDCS-04001073.translation: To the Divine Shades. Iulia Fortunata, daughter of Fortunatianus, dutiful, lived 40 years; she is buried here. Claudia Victoria, dutiful, lived 5 years. Claudius Victor made (this) for his most dutiful parents. To the Divine Shades. Claudius Kato, dutiful, lived 65 years; he is buried here. Claudius Fortunius, dutiful, lived 23 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-04001073.summary: A complex funerary monument recording the deaths of several individuals, including Iulia Fortunata, Claudia Victoria, Claudius Kato, and Claudius Fortunius, likely spanning different generations and indicating family relationships, from the imperial period.

EDCS-04001074.translation: To the Divine Shades. CAN ON lived 63 years; he is buried here. Tiberius Claudius Canopus, dutiful, sober, just son of Tiberius Claudius Rogatus, of the Quirina tribe, lived 81 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-04001074.summary: A tombstone for Tiberius Claudius Canopus, detailing his virtues and family lineage, likely from the early imperial period.

EDCS-04001075.translation: To the Divine Shades. Claudius Citinus lived 25 years. To the Divine Shades. Lucius Claudius Lucinus, dutiful, lived 75 years.
EDCS-04001075.summary: Two separate funerary dedications, one for Claudius Citinus and another for Lucius Claudius Lucinus, both indicating lifespans and likely burial, from the imperial period.

EDCS-04001077.translation: To the Divine Shades. Tiberius Claudius Dius Senecianus, dutiful, lived 60 years.
EDCS-04001077.summary: A funerary inscription for Tiberius Claudius Dius Senecianus, noting his dutifulness and lifespan, dating from the imperial period.

EDCS-04001078.translation: To the Divine Shades. Tiberius Claudius Donatus.
EDCS-04001078.summary: A simple funerary dedication to Tiberius Claudius Donatus, likely indicating his death and burial, from the imperial period.

EDCS-04001079.translation: To the Divine Shades. For his dutiful father Felici and his brother Hermeti. Claudius Victor made (this).

EDCS-04001184.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Flavia Zaba lived... She is buried here.
EDCS-04001184.summary: This funerary epitaph records the burial of Flavia Zaba.

EDCS-04001187.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Tettius Fortunatus, dutiful, [lived] years...
EDCS-04001187.summary: This fragmentary funerary epitaph names Tettius Fortunatus.

EDCS-04001191.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Caius Gabinius Sabinus, dutiful, lived 75 years. He is buried here.
EDCS-04001191.summary: This funerary epitaph records the death and burial of Caius Gabinius Sabinus, who lived to be 75 years old.

EDCS-04001192.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. For Gabinia Macrina, freedwoman of Dudda, dutiful, lived 30 years. She is buried here.
EDCS-04001192.summary: This funerary epitaph records the death and burial of Gabinia Macrina, freedwoman of Dudda, who lived to be 30 years old.

EDCS-04001193.translation: ... lived 70 years. She is buried here. ... Quirinus Gaetulicus, dutiful, lived 80 years. He is buried here.

EDCS-04001194.summary: This fragmentary epitaph records the name Gallonian and an incomplete lifespan.

EDCS-04001195.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Clodia Ianuaria, dutiful, lived 75 years. Geminia Privata, dutiful, lived 17 years. Geminia Castula, dutiful, lived 47 years. Geminius Castus, dutiful, lived 90 years. Geminius Rogatianus, dutiful, lived 35 years. Geminius Privatus, dutiful, lived 15 years.
EDCS-04001195.summary: This funerary epitaph lists the lifespans of six individuals, likely family members, including Clodia Ianuaria, Geminia Privata, Geminia Castula, Geminius Castus, Geminius Rogatianus, and Geminius Privatus.

EDCS-04001196.summary: This epitaph records the lifespan of Primus Geminius, who lived to be 80 years old.

EDCS-04001199.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Sentia Donata, dutiful, lived 65 years. Publius Hordionius Commodus, dutiful, lived 85 years. He is buried here.
EDCS-04001199.summary: This funerary epitaph records the death and burial of Publius Hordionius Commodus, who lived to be 85 years old, and also mentions Sentia Donata.

EDCS-04001202.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Quintus Hordionius.
EDCS-04001202.summary: This is a funerary inscription dedicated to the Divine Shades by Quintus Hordionius, likely a tombstone inscription.

EDCS-04001203.translation: Here lies. Sacred to the Divine Shades. Hortensius and Claudia Florida, from Bizzo, for their daughter Hortensia Privata, a simple, pious matron, lived 20 years. Claudia Anthusa, her pious grandmother, lived 70 years. Here lies.
EDCS-04001203.summary: This funerary inscription records the burial of Hortensia Privata and her grandmother Claudia Anthusa, placed by Hortensius and Claudia Florida.

EDCS-04001204.summary: This is a funerary inscription recording the life span of Hortensia Celsina.

EDCS-04001205.translation: Hostilia Urbana, daughter of Lucius, lived 60 years. Here lies.
EDCS-04001205.summary: This funerary inscription records the burial and age of Hostilia Urbana.

EDCS-04001206.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Caius Iulius Aelianus lived 25 years. Here lies. Caius Iulius Iovinus, father, to his dearest son.
EDCS-04001206.summary: This funerary inscription records the death of Caius Iulius Aelianus, dedicated by his father Caius Iulius Iovinus.

EDCS-04001207.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Caius Iulius Aemilianus, pious, lived 65 years.
EDCS-04001207.summary: This is a funerary inscription dedicated to the Divine Shades for Caius Iulius Aemilianus, noting his piety and age.

EDCS-04001208.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Iulius Cacus lived [X] years.
EDCS-04001208.summary: This is a fragmentary funerary inscription for Iulius Cacus, indicating a dedication to the Divine Shades and an incomplete age.

EDCS-04001211.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Sacred to the Divine Shades. Caius Iulius Extricatus.
EDCS-04001211.summary: This inscription, with a repeated dedication to the Divine Shades, mentions Caius Iulius Extricatus, likely a tombstone.

EDCS-04001212.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Iulius Faustus lived 74 years, but lived. Sacred to the Divine Shades. Iulius Dativus lived 74 years, but lived.
EDCS-04001212.summary: This inscription records the ages of two individuals, Iulius Faustus and Iulius Dativus, with a curious repetition of 'sed vixit' (but lived), and dedicates them to the Divine Shades.

EDCS-04001213.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Iulius Faustus, pious, lived 65 years, but lived well. He is buried here.
EDCS-04001213.summary: This funerary inscription dedicates Iulius Faustus to the Divine Shades, noting his piety, age, and that he lived well.

EDCS-04001214.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Iulia Rogata lived 5 years; she rests here. Iulius Festus lived 25 years; he rests here.
EDCS-04001214.summary: This funerary inscription records the burial of Iulia Rogata and Iulius Festus, likely family members.

EDCS-04001215.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Iulia Successa, dutiful, lived 17 years. Sacred to the departed spirits. Caius Iulius Festus, dutiful, lived 61 years; he rests here.
EDCS-04001215.summary: This funerary inscription records the burial of Iulia Successa and Caius Iulius Festus, likely family members.

EDCS-04001216.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Caius Iulius Fortunatus lived 85 years; he rests here. Sacred to the departed spirits. Fabia Secunda, daughter of Fabius, lived 75 years; she rests here.
EDCS-04001216.summary: This funerary inscription records the burial of Caius Iulius Fortunatus and Fabia Secunda, likely a couple.

EDCS-04001217.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Lucius Iulius Generosus lived 9 years.
EDCS-04001217.summary: This funerary inscription records the death of a child, Lucius Iulius Generosus.

EDCS-04001218.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Caius Iulius Honoratus, dutiful, son of Germanius, of the Quirina tribe, lived 20 years.
EDCS-04001218.summary: This funerary inscription records the death of a young man, Caius Iulius Honoratus.

EDCS-04001219.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Iulius Honoratus, dutiful, son of Quirina, lived 6 years. Iulia Venusta.
EDCS-04001219.summary: This funerary inscription records the death of a child, Iulius Honoratus, and likely his sister, Iulia Venusta.

EDCS-04001221.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Iulius Ianuarius Aiburhu lived 80 years.
EDCS-04001221.summary: This funerary inscription records the death of Iulius Ianuarius Aiburhu.

EDCS-04001222.translation: Caius Iulius Longinus, dutiful, lived 4 years; he rests here.
EDCS-04001222.summary: This funerary inscription records the burial of Caius Iulius Longinus, a young child.

EDCS-04001223.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Iulius Maximianus Gallianus, dutiful, lived 66 years and 4 months.
EDCS-04001223.summary: This funerary inscription records the death of Iulius Maximianus Gallianus.

EDCS-04001224.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Valeria Fortunata, dutiful, lived 53 years; she rests here. Titus Iulius Massuricus, dutiful, lived 56 years; he rests here. Titus Iulius Sabinus, son of... F(lavius) P(atronus)?
EDCS-04001224.summary: This funerary inscription records the burial of two individuals, Valeria Fortunata and Titus Iulius Massuricus, possibly a couple, with a partial dedication to Titus Iulius Sabinus.

EDCS-04001225.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Gaius Julius Melaudus lived 51 years. Calpurnia Donata made this at her own expense.
EDCS-04001225.summary: A funerary epitaph for Gaius Julius Melaudus, funded by Calpurnia Donata.

EDCS-04001226.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Lucius Julius Nepos lived 75 years. He is buried here.
EDCS-04001226.summary: A funerary epitaph for Lucius Julius Nepos, recording his age and burial.

EDCS-04001227.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Antonia Victoria lived 71 years. Sacred to the departed spirits. Gaius Julius Paulus the pious lived 95 years. Sacred to the departed spirits. Iulia Paulina the pious lived 27 years.
EDCS-04001227.summary: A funerary epitaph recording the lives and ages of Antonia Victoria, Gaius Julius Paulus, and Iulia Paulina.

EDCS-04001228.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Lucius Julius Politius lived 59 years.
EDCS-04001228.summary: A funerary epitaph for Lucius Julius Politius, recording his age.

EDCS-04001229.translation: C. C. Hore[nus], son of Iulius Priscianus Pomponianus, pious, lived 22 years. Ovs Primianus Pomponianus, pious, lived 53 years. He is buried here.
EDCS-04001229.summary: A funerary epitaph for Ovs Primianus Pomponianus, also mentioning his son C. C. Hore[nus].

EDCS-04001230.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Lucius Julius Privatus lived 5 years.
EDCS-04001230.summary: A funerary epitaph for Lucius Julius Privatus, recording his age.

EDCS-04001231.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Decimus Julius Rogatus lived 85 years. He is buried here.
EDCS-04001231.summary: A funerary epitaph for Decimus Julius Rogatus, recording his age and burial.

EDCS-04001232.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Gaius Julius Rufus the pious lived 46 years. Sacred to the departed spirits. Maecia Ianuaria the pious lived 66 years.
EDCS-04001232.summary: A funerary epitaph recording the lives and ages of Gaius Julius Rufus and Maecia Ianuaria.

EDCS-04001233.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Marcus Julius Sabinus, son of Gaius, the pious, lived 21 years.
EDCS-04001233.summary: A funerary epitaph for Marcus Julius Sabinus, son of Gaius, recording his age.

EDCS-04001234.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Iulius Saturbalius the pious lived 55 years. He is buried here.
EDCS-04001234.summary: A funerary epitaph for Iulius Saturbalius, recording his age and burial.

EDCS-04001235.translation: To the Divine Spirits. Clodia Galla, dutiful, lived 103 years. Iulius Saturninus Clodianus, dutiful, lived 57 years.
EDCS-04001235.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Clodia Galla and Iulius Saturninus Clodianus, recording their ages at death.

EDCS-04001236.translation: To the Divine Spirits. For Iulius Geminianus, son of Lucius, of the Quirina tribe, dutiful, who lived 91 years, he is buried here. Iuliae Matrona and Donata made this for their father.
EDCS-04001236.summary: This is a funerary inscription set up by Iuliae Matrona and Donata for their father, Iulius Geminianus, recording his age at death.

EDCS-04001237.translation: To the Divine Spirits. Lucius Iulius Saturninus, son of Maximi, dutiful, lived 80 years, he is buried here.
EDCS-04001237.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Lucius Iulius Saturninus, recording his age at death and burial.

EDCS-04001238.translation: To the Divine Spirits. Iulius Silvanus, dutiful, lived 85 years, he is buried here. Iulia Maior lived 41 years.
EDCS-04001238.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Iulius Silvanus and Iulia Maior, recording their ages at death and burial.

EDCS-04001239.translation: To the Divine Spirits. Caius Iulius Surus, dutiful, lived 50 years. Lepidius Evassius, dutiful, lived 18 years, he is buried here.
EDCS-04001239.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Caius Iulius Surus and Lepidius Evassius, recording their ages at death and burial.

EDCS-04001240.translation: To the Divine Spirits. Iulius Victor lived 55 years.
EDCS-04001240.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Iulius Victor, recording his age at death.

EDCS-04001241.translation: To the Divine Spirits. Magnia Maxima, dutiful, lived 67 years. Marcus Iulius Victor Victorianus, dutiful, lived 81 years, they are buried here.
EDCS-04001241.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Magnia Maxima and Marcus Iulius Victor Victorianus, recording their ages at death and burial.

EDCS-04001242.translation: To the Divine Spirits. Caius Iulius Vitalis lived 62 years.
EDCS-04001242.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Caius Iulius Vitalis, recording his age at death.

EDCS-04001243.translation: To the Divine Spirits. Iulia Fortunata, dutiful, lived 45 years. To the Divine Spirits. Caius Iulius Urbanus, dutiful, lived 35 years. To the Divine Spirits. Caius Iulius Datulus, dutiful, lived 12 years. To the Divine Spirits. Iulia Severa, dutiful, lived 9 years.
EDCS-04001243.summary: This is a multi-part funerary inscription recording the ages at death of Iulia Fortunata, Caius Iulius Urbanus, Caius Iulius Datulus, and Iulia Severa.

EDCS-04001244.translation: To the Divine Spirits. Lucius Iulius Zabo, son of Lucius, lived 21 years and 5 months, he is buried here.
EDCS-04001244.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Lucius Iulius Zabo, recording his age at death and burial.

EDCS-04001245.translation: Sacred to the Divine Spirits. Iulius Donatus lived 62 years. Iulius Atus [lived...].
EDCS-04001245.summary: This funerary inscription records the lives of two individuals, Iulius Donatus and Iulius Atus.

EDCS-04001246.translation: Sacred to the Divine Spirits. Caius Iulius Pius lived 65 years.
EDCS-04001246.summary: This funerary inscription records the lifespan of Caius Iulius Pius.

EDCS-04001247.translation: Sacred to the Divine Spirits. Marcus Iu[lius...]
EDCS-04001247.summary: This is a fragmentary funerary inscription for someone named Marcus.

EDCS-04001248.translation: Iulia Pia lived 86 years. She is buried here.
EDCS-04001248.summary: This funerary inscription records the burial and lifespan of Iulia Pia.

EDCS-04001249.translation: Sacred to the Divine Spirits. Iulia Concessa Pia lived 11 years. She is buried here.
EDCS-04001249.summary: This funerary inscription records the burial and short lifespan of Iulia Concessa Pia.

EDCS-04001250.translation: Sacred to the Divine Spirits. Iulia Fecunda Pia lived 31 years. Maecia Casta Pia lived 62 years. She is buried here.
EDCS-04001250.summary: This funerary inscription records the lives and burial of Iulia Fecunda Pia and Maecia Casta Pia.

EDCS-04001251.translation: Sacred to the Divine Spirits. Iulia Fortunata Pia lived 30 years. Claudius Martialis Pius lived 6 years. He is buried here. Antonia Victorina Pia lived 14 years. She is buried here.
EDCS-04001251.summary: This funerary inscription records the lives and burials of Iulia Fortunata Pia, Claudius Martialis Pius, and Antonia Victorina Pia.

EDCS-04001252.translation: Sacred to the Divine Spirits. Iulia Magna Pia lived 30 years. She is buried here.
EDCS-04001252.summary: This funerary inscription records the burial and lifespan of Iulia Magna Pia.

EDCS-04001254.translation: Sacred to the Divine Spirits. Iulia Matrona Pia lived 75 years. She is buried here.
EDCS-04001254.summary: This funerary inscription records the burial and lifespan of Iulia Matrona Pia.

EDCS-04001256.translation: Sacred to the Divine Spirits. Iulia Severa, daughter of Lucius, Pia lived 60 years. She is buried here.
EDCS-04001256.summary: This funerary inscription records the burial and lifespan of Iulia Severa, daughter of Lucius.

EDCS-04001257.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Caia Iulia Thudel, also known as Ospica, a devoted woman, lived 40 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-04001257.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Caia Iulia Thudel, recording her devotion and lifespan.

EDCS-04001258.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Iulia Tzaiza and Donata lived 80 years; they are buried here.
EDCS-04001258.summary: This funerary epitaph records the lives of two women, Iulia Tzaiza and Donata.

EDCS-04001261.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Tiberia Claudia Tertulla, daughter of Lucius, a devoted woman, lived 53 years; she is buried here. Sacred to the departed spirits. Caius Iunius Fortunatus, a devoted man, lived 45 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-04001261.summary: This epitaph records the lives and burials of two individuals, Tiberia Claudia Tertulla and Caius Iunius Fortunatus.

EDCS-04001262.translation: Iunia Victoria, a devoted woman, lived 60 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-04001262.summary: This funerary epitaph records the lifespan and burial of Iunia Victoria.

EDCS-04001263.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Quintus Laberius Fortunatus, a devoted man, lived 37 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-04001263.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Quintus Laberius Fortunatus, recording his devotion and lifespan.

EDCS-04001264.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Laberius Privatianus, a devoted man, lived 35 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-04001264.summary: This funerary epitaph records the lifespan and burial of Laberius Privatianus.

EDCS-04001265.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Fundania Fortunata, a devoted woman, lived 71 years. Decimus Laelius Gemellus, a devoted man, lived 81 years. Laelia Victoria made this for her parents.
EDCS-04001265.summary: This funerary monument records the lives of Fundania Fortunata and Decimus Laelius Gemellus, and states it was made by their daughter Laelia Victoria.

EDCS-04001266.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Laelia Festa, a woman of most praiseworthy memory.
EDCS-04001266.summary: This funerary epitaph commemorates Laelia Festa, highlighting her excellent reputation.

EDCS-04001267.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Caius Liceius Felix lived 80 years; he is buried here. Sacred to the departed spirits. Claudia Namgidde lived 46 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-04001267.summary: This epitaph records the lives and burials of two individuals, Caius Liceius Felix and Claudia Namgidde.

EDCS-04001268.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Caius Licinius Felix lived 75 years. Catia Marta lived 81 years.
EDCS-04001268.summary: This inscription records the lifespans of Caius Licinius Felix and Catia Marta.

EDCS-04001269.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. She lived piously for 113 years and is buried here. Caius Licinius Largus of the Quirina tribe lived piously for 82 years and is buried here. Licinius made this monument at his own expense.
EDCS-04001269.summary: This epitaph records the burial of Caius Licinius Largus and another individual who lived to an exceptional age, with the monument funded by Largus himself.

EDCS-04001270.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Licinius Macer lived for 18 years.
EDCS-04001270.summary: This is a tomb inscription commemorating Licinius Macer, who died at the age of 18.

EDCS-04001272.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Caius Licinius Saturninus lived piously for 75 years and is buried here. Claudia Privata lived for 70 years and is buried here.
EDCS-04001272.summary: This epitaph records the burial of Caius Licinius Saturninus and Claudia Privata, noting their ages at death.

EDCS-04001273.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Caius Lollius, son of Lollius, lived piously for 38 years.
EDCS-04001273.summary: This tomb inscription commemorates Caius Lollius, son of Lollius, noting his age at death.

EDCS-04001274.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Lucius Lollius Datus lived piously for 23 years and is buried here.
EDCS-04001274.summary: This epitaph records the burial of Lucius Lollius Datus, who died at the age of 23.

EDCS-04001275.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Lucia Lollia Dativa lived for 25 years and is buried here. Sacred to the departed spirits. Lucia Lollia Saturnina lived for 25 years.
EDCS-04001275.summary: This epitaph records the burial of two women, Lucia Lollia Dativa and Lucia Lollia Saturnina, both of whom died at the age of 25.

EDCS-04001277.translation: Lucius Lucilius Donatus is buried here. He lived for 85 years.
EDCS-04001277.summary: This tomb inscription records the burial of Lucius Lucilius Donatus and his age at death.

EDCS-04001279.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Lucius Maecius Firmus lived for 60 years and is buried here.
EDCS-04001279.summary: This epitaph records the burial of Lucius Maecius Firmus, noting his age at death.

EDCS-04001280.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Quintus Maecius Madauritanus lived piously for 50 years and is buried here.
EDCS-04001280.summary: This tomb inscription commemorates Quintus Maecius Madauritanus, noting his origin from Madaura and his age at death.

EDCS-04001281.translation: Quintius Maecius lived 90 years and lies here.
EDCS-04001281.summary: This epitaph records the burial of Quintius Maecius and his advanced age at death.

EDCS-04001282.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Maecia Emerita lived 4 years. Maecia Certa pia lived 8 years. She is buried here.
EDCS-04001282.summary: This is a funerary inscription recording the lives and burials of two individuals, Maecia Emerita and Maecia Certa pia.

EDCS-04001283.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Maecia Semmudah lived 5 years. She is buried here. Sacred to the departed spirits. Titinia Ianuaria lived 45 years. She is buried here.
EDCS-04001283.summary: This funerary inscription records the lives and burials of two individuals, Maecia Semmudah and Titinia Ianuaria.

EDCS-04001284.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Maenius Gaius lived 80 years. He is buried here.
EDCS-04001284.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Maenius Gaius, recording his age and burial.

EDCS-04001285.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Publius Magnius Pulas.
EDCS-04001285.summary: This is a fragmentary funerary inscription dedicated to Publius Magnius Pulas.

EDCS-04001286.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Magnius.
EDCS-04001286.summary: This is a fragmentary funerary inscription dedicated to Magnius.

EDCS-04001287.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Pompeia Prima pia lived 65 years. She is buried here. Sacred to the departed spirits. Manilius Aris pius lived 75 years. He is buried here.
EDCS-04001287.summary: This funerary inscription records the lives and burials of two individuals, Pompeia Prima pia and Manilius Aris pius.

EDCS-04001288.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Manilia Prima pia lived 20 years. May your bones rest well with you.
EDCS-04001288.summary: This funerary inscription records the life of Manilia Prima pia and includes a common wish for the deceased to rest in peace.

EDCS-04001289.translation: Maecius son of [---], Quirina Marcellus pius lived [---] years. He is buried here.
EDCS-04001289.summary: This funerary inscription records the life and burial of Maecius, son of [---] and Quirina Marcellus.

EDCS-04001290.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Marchia Pomponia lived 2 years and 7 months. She is buried here. Sacred to the departed spirits. Publius Marchius Faustinus pius lived 81 years. He is buried here. Sacred to the departed spirits. Publius Marchius Datus pius lived 75 years. He is buried here. Sacred to the departed spirits. Audenia Pomponia pia lived 75 years. May your bones rest well.
EDCS-04001290.summary: This funerary inscription records the lives and burials of four individuals: Marchia Pomponia, Publius Marchius Faustinus pius, Publius Marchius Datus pius, and Audenia Pomponia pia.

EDCS-04001291.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Caius Marius Barih pius lived 53 years. He is buried here. Sacred to the departed spirits. Maria Saturnina pia lived 23 years. She is buried here. Iulia Galli filia Quirina Prima pia lived 65 years. She is buried here.
EDCS-04001291.summary: This funerary inscription records the lives and burials of three individuals: Caius Marius Barih pius, Maria Saturnina pia, and Iulia Galli filia Quirina Prima pia.

EDCS-04001292.translation: Aelia Riia, devoted, lived 105 years. She is buried here. Gaius Marius Barih, devoted, lived 70 years.
EDCS-04001292.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Aelia Riia and Gaius Marius Barih, likely a married couple, with their ages at death.

EDCS-04001293.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Vitruvia Secura, devoted and sober, lived 80 years. Gaius Marius Quirina Fortunatus, devoted, lived 75 years. He is buried here.
EDCS-04001293.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Vitruvia Secura and Gaius Marius Quirina Fortunatus, recording their ages at death and burial location.

EDCS-04001294.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Gaius Marius Fortunatus Romanianus, devoted, lived 9 years. Plautia Romana, devoted, lived 25 years. Maria Plautilla, devoted, lived 1 year. Gaius Marius Securus Rogatianus placed them here, his most beloved wife and children.
EDCS-04001294.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Gaius Marius Fortunatus Romanianus, Plautia Romana, and Maria Plautilla, with Gaius Marius Securus Rogatianus dedicating the monument to his wife and children.

EDCS-04001295.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Iulia Aprulla. Sacred to the departed spirits. Caius Marius Mar.
EDCS-04001295.summary: This is a fragmentary funerary epitaph, likely for Iulia Aprulla and Caius Marius Mar, with repeated dedications to the departed spirits.

EDCS-04001297.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Caius Mattius, son of Sextus, Quirina Rusticus, devoted, lived 75 years. He is buried here.
EDCS-04001297.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Caius Mattius Quirina Rusticus, recording his age at death and burial.

EDCS-04001298.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Caia Mattia Ocar, devoted, lived 70 years. Sacred to the departed spirits. Sacred to the departed spirits. Caia Mattia Pupa, devoted, lived 7 years. Caius Mattius Pacatus, devoted, lived 6 years.
EDCS-04001298.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Caia Mattia Ocar, Caia Mattia Pupa, and Caius Mattius Pacatus, recording their ages at death and dedicating the inscription to the departed spirits.

EDCS-04001299.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Fabborn Metilius lived 70 years and 5 [months/days]. He is buried here.
EDCS-04001299.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Fabborn Metilius, recording his age at death and burial.

EDCS-04001300.translation: ria, daughter of Lucius, Mina, devoted, lived 23 years and 1 month. She is buried here.
EDCS-04001300.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Mina, daughter of Lucius, recording her age at death and burial.

EDCS-04001301.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Caius Minucius Optatus, devoted, lived [years]. Pompeia Fortunata, devoted, lived [years]. Caius Minucius Datus, devoted, lived [years]. He made the monument.
EDCS-04001301.summary: This is a fragmentary funerary epitaph with dedications to the departed spirits, mentioning Caius Minucius Optatus, Pompeia Fortunata, and Caius Minucius Datus, who made the monument.

EDCS-04001302.translation: Cnaeus Minucius Pudens lived 70 years. He is buried here.
EDCS-04001302.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Cnaeus Minucius Pudens, recording his age at death and burial.

EDCS-04001303.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Pescennia Secunda, dutiful, lived 30 years; she is buried here. Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Modius Maior, dutiful, lived 75 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-04001303.summary: This funerary inscription records the deaths and ages of Pescennia Secunda and Modius Maior.

EDCS-04001304.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Veneriae, dutiful, lived 95 years; she is buried here. Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Publius Modius Martialis, dutiful, lived 85 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-04001304.summary: This funerary inscription records the deaths and ages of Veneriae and Publius Modius Martialis.

EDCS-04001305.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Caius Modius Nepos, dutiful, lived 15 years; he is buried here. Modius Cuntianus, dutiful, lived 15 years. Caius Modius Honoratus, dutiful, lived [X] years. Modia Secunda, dutiful, lived [X] years; she is buried here.
EDCS-04001305.summary: This funerary inscription records the deaths and ages of Caius Modius Nepos, Modius Cuntianus, Caius Modius Honoratus, and Modia Secunda.

EDCS-04001306.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Modia Paulina, dutiful, lived 53 years. Publius Modius Primus, dutiful, lived 37 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-04001306.summary: This funerary inscription records the deaths and ages of Modia Paulina and Publius Modius Primus.

EDCS-04001307.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Lucius Munatius Commodus, dutiful, lived 80 years. Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Verulania Candida, dutiful, lived 90 years. Munatia Flaviana [died?].
EDCS-04001307.summary: This funerary inscription records the deaths and ages of Lucius Munatius Commodus and Verulania Candida, and mentions Munatia Flaviana.

EDCS-04001308.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Munatia Iucunda, dutiful, lived 18 years; she is buried here. Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Lucius Munatius Felix, dutiful, lived 15 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-04001308.summary: This funerary inscription records the deaths and ages of Munatia Iucunda and Lucius Munatius Felix.

EDCS-04001309.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Munatia Fortunata, dutiful, lived 75 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-04001309.summary: This funerary inscription records the death and age of Munatia Fortunata.

EDCS-04001310.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Mundicia Marchia, dutiful, lived 75 years.
EDCS-04001310.summary: This funerary inscription records the death and age of Mundicia Marchia.

EDCS-04001311.translation: Mustacia, dutiful, lived 32 years; she is buried here. Casta, dutiful, lived 13 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-04001311.summary: This funerary inscription records the deaths and ages of Mustacia and Casta.

EDCS-04001312.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Mustiolus, dutiful, lived 28 years; he is buried here. Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Cara, dutiful, lived 60 years; she is buried here. Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Fructus, dutiful, lived 30 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-04001312.summary: This funerary inscription records the deaths and ages of Mustiolus, Cara, and Fructus.

EDCS-04001313.translation: Namphame, dutiful, lived 51 years. She is buried here with her freedmen.
EDCS-04001313.summary: This is a tombstone for Namphame, who lived 51 years and is buried with her freedmen.

EDCS-04001314.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Nonius Donatus, dutiful, lived 57 years. He is buried here.
EDCS-04001314.summary: This is a tombstone for Nonius Donatus, who lived 57 years and is buried here.

EDCS-04001316.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Novellus, dutiful, lived 30 years.
EDCS-04001316.summary: This is a tombstone for Novellus, who lived 30 years.

EDCS-04001318.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Nuciva Fortunata, daughter of Caius, dutiful, lived 16 years. She is buried here. Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Flavia Urbana, dutiful, lived 40 years. Cornelius Arnensis, dutiful, lived 63 years. He is buried here.
EDCS-04001318.summary: This is a tombstone for Nuciva Fortunata and Flavia Urbana, who lived 16 and 40 years respectively, and Cornelius Arnensis who lived 63 years.

EDCS-04001319.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Obstoria Honorata, daughter of Obstorius Fortunatus, dutiful, lived 27 years. She is buried here.
EDCS-04001319.summary: This is a tombstone for Obstoria Honorata, daughter of Obstorius Fortunatus, who lived 27 years.

EDCS-04001320.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Octavia Ianuaria lived 86 years.
EDCS-04001320.summary: This is a tombstone for Octavia Ianuaria, who lived 86 years.

EDCS-04001321.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Otacilia Bella, dutiful, lived 66 years. She is buried here. Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Tilia Materona, dutiful, lived 23 years. May the earth lie light upon you both, and upon your names Otacilia Kasta and Otacilius Titor.
EDCS-04001321.summary: This is a tombstone for Otacilia Bella and Tilia Materona, who lived 66 and 23 years respectively, with a dedication to Otacilia Kasta and Otacilius Titor.

EDCS-04001322.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Sextus Pedius Luciscus lived 71 years. He is buried here.
EDCS-04001322.summary: This is a tombstone for Sextus Pedius Luciscus, who lived 71 years.

EDCS-04001323.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Peregrina, dutiful, lived 55 years. She is buried here. Us Potitus, dutiful, lived 83 years. He is buried here.
EDCS-04001323.summary: This is a tombstone for Peregrina, who lived 55 years, and Us Potitus, who lived 83 years.

EDCS-04001324.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Lucius Pescennius Honoratus lived 18 years. He is buried here.
EDCS-04001324.summary: This is a tombstone for Lucius Pescennius Honoratus, who lived 18 years.

EDCS-04001325.translation: To the Divine Shades. Gaius Pinneus Faustus, dutiful, lived 85 years. He rests here.
EDCS-04001325.summary: This is a tombstone inscription recording the lifespan and burial of Gaius Pinneus Faustus.

EDCS-04001326.translation: Gnaeus Pompeius Lucinus lived 85 years. Munatia Matrona lived 60 years.
EDCS-04001326.summary: This tombstone inscription records the lifespans of Gnaeus Pompeius Lucinus and Munatia Matrona.

EDCS-04001328.translation: Pompeius Pastor lived 20 years. He rests here.
EDCS-04001328.summary: This tombstone inscription records the lifespan and burial of Pompeius Pastor.

EDCS-04001329.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Lucius Pompeius Rogatus lived 50 years. He rests here.
EDCS-04001329.summary: This is a tombstone inscription recording the lifespan and burial of Lucius Pompeius Rogatus.

EDCS-04001330.translation: Pompeius Salvius lived 85 years. He rests here.
EDCS-04001330.summary: This tombstone inscription records the lifespan and burial of Pompeius Salvius.

EDCS-04001331.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Lucius Pompeius Terminalis, dutiful, lived 90 years. He rests here.
EDCS-04001331.summary: This is a tombstone inscription recording the lifespan and burial of Lucius Pompeius Terminalis.

EDCS-04001332.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Pompeius Tertullinus, dutiful, lived 91 years. He rests here.
EDCS-04001332.summary: This is a tombstone inscription recording the lifespan and burial of Pompeius Tertullinus.

EDCS-04001333.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Pompeia Bona, dutiful, lived 75 years.
EDCS-04001333.summary: This is a tombstone inscription recording the lifespan of Pompeia Bona.

EDCS-04001335.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Marcus Pomponius Similis, dutiful, lived 60 years. He rests here.
EDCS-04001335.summary: This is a tombstone inscription recording the lifespan and burial of Marcus Pomponius Similis.

EDCS-04001336.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Pomponia Casta, dutiful, lived 28 years. She rests here.
EDCS-04001336.summary: This is a tombstone inscription recording the lifespan and burial of Pomponia Casta.

EDCS-04001337.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Pomponia Tertulla, dutiful, lived 70 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-04001337.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Pomponia Tertulla, recording her name, dutiful character, age at death, and burial.

EDCS-04001338.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Secunda, dutiful daughter of Pontilia Victorini, lived 29 years, 10 months, and 24 days; she is buried here.
EDCS-04001338.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Secunda, identifying her parents, dutiful character, age at death, and burial.

EDCS-04001339.summary: This is a brief funerary epitaph for Priscus, recording his name and age at death.

EDCS-04001340.translation: To Decimus C. n. [?] Pudentilla, most chaste. [M. T. P. A. - possibly a formula or relationship].
EDCS-04001340.summary: This is a dedication, possibly funerary or dedicatory, to a most chaste woman named Pudentilla, with unclear abbreviations.

EDCS-04001341.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Marcus Pullaenius Peculiaris, dutiful, lived 18 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-04001341.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Marcus Pullaenius Peculiaris, recording his name, dutiful character, age at death, and burial.

EDCS-04001342.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Quintus Musa, dutiful, lived 2 years.
EDCS-04001342.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Quintus Musa, recording his name, dutiful character, and age at death.

EDCS-04001343.translation: Cuintus Ciuzianus lived 3 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-04001343.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Cuintus Ciuzianus, recording his name, age at death, and burial.

EDCS-04001345.translation: Fortunata lived 71 years. Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Rogatus, dutiful, [lived] 1 year.
EDCS-04001345.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Fortunata and Rogatus, recording their names, ages at death, and dutiful characters.

EDCS-04001347.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Caius Rusticelius Avitianus, dutiful, lived 40 years.
EDCS-04001347.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Caius Rusticelius Avitianus, recording his name, dutiful character, and age at death.

EDCS-04001348.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Quintus Rusticelius Honoratus, dutiful son of Caius, lived 36 years and 4 months; he is buried here.
EDCS-04001348.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Quintus Rusticelius Honoratus, identifying his father, dutiful character, age at death, and burial.

EDCS-04001349.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Rusticelia Namphadora, dutiful, lived 10 years, is buried here.
EDCS-04001349.summary: This is a tombstone recording the death of Rusticelia Namphadora, who lived for 10 years.

EDCS-04001350.summary: This epitaph records the death of Salus Rogati, who lived for 77 years.

EDCS-04001351.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Gaius Sallustius Dexter, dutiful, lived 85 years, is buried here. Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Flavia Tertia, dutiful, lived 105 years, is buried here.
EDCS-04001351.summary: This tombstone records the deaths of Gaius Sallustius Dexter (85 years) and Flavia Tertia (105 years).

EDCS-04001352.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Sallustia Baebbia, dutiful, lived 45 years, is buried here.
EDCS-04001352.summary: This is a tombstone recording the death of Sallustia Baebbia, who lived for 45 years.

EDCS-04001354.translation: Saturnina, dutiful, lived 19 years, is buried here.
EDCS-04001354.summary: This epitaph records the death of Saturnina, who lived for 19 years.

EDCS-04001355.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Marcus Scantius Faustus, son of Lucius, of the Quirina tribe, dutiful, lived 105 years.
EDCS-04001355.summary: This tombstone records the death of Marcus Scantius Faustus, who lived for 105 years.

EDCS-04001357.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Lucius Scribonius Felix Pompeianus, son of Lucius, of the Quirina tribe, dutiful. Petronia Ianuaria, devoted wife, lived 82 years. Lucius Scribonius Ianuarius Petronianus, son of Lucius, of the Quirina tribe, dutiful, lived 32 years, is buried here.
EDCS-04001357.summary: This tombstone records the deaths of Petronia Ianuaria (82 years) and Lucius Scribonius Ianuarius Petronianus (32 years), with mention of Lucius Scribonius Felix Pompeianus.

EDCS-04001359.summary: This brief inscription records the lifespan of Seccunda as 7 years, with an illegible addition.

EDCS-04001360.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Sempronia Ianuaria, dutiful, lived 27 years, is buried here. Sempronia Extricata, dutiful, lived 85 years, is buried here. Iasuc Adiutoris, dutiful, lived 105 years, is buried here.
EDCS-04001360.summary: This tombstone records the deaths of Sempronia Ianuaria (27 years), Sempronia Extricata (85 years), and Iasuc Adiutoris (105 years).

EDCS-04001361.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Servilia Marcella, dutiful, lived 70 years. Gaius Servilius Germanus, dutiful, lived [---]. Gaius Servilius Donatus, dutiful, lived 15 years, is buried here.
EDCS-04001361.summary: This tombstone records the deaths of Servilia Marcella (70 years) and Gaius Servilius Donatus (15 years), with mention of Gaius Servilius Germanus.

EDCS-04001362.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. Marcus Servilius Primus Clodianus, son of..., [dedicated this].
EDCS-04001362.summary: This is a funerary inscription dedicated to Marcus Servilius Primus Clodianus.

EDCS-04001363.translation: Marcus Servilius Victorinus Clodianus, also known as Malimorius, lived for 29 years, 9 months, and 26 days.
EDCS-04001363.summary: This funerary inscription records the life and death of Marcus Servilius Victorinus Clodianus.

EDCS-04001364.translation: Dius Servilianus the pious lived for 68 years and is buried here.
EDCS-04001364.summary: This funerary inscription records the death and burial of Dius Servilianus.

EDCS-04001366.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. Silicia, daughter of Lucius Praenestinus, pious, lived for 40 years and is buried here.
EDCS-04001366.summary: This funerary inscription records the death and burial of Silicia.

EDCS-04001367.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. Similis, a good man, lived for 23 years.
EDCS-04001367.summary: This funerary inscription records the death of Similis.

EDCS-04001368.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. Sipica, mother, Palmula, pious, lived for 45 years.
EDCS-04001368.summary: This funerary inscription records the death of Sipica Palmula.

EDCS-04001369.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. Quinta Stavia Ianuaria lived for 86 years.
EDCS-04001369.summary: This funerary inscription records the death of Quinta Stavia Ianuaria.

EDCS-04001370.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. Gaius Sutorius Martialis, pious, lived for 25 years and is buried here. Gaius Pinneius Crescens, pious, lived for 25 years and is buried here. They were deceived by robbers.
EDCS-04001370.summary: This funerary inscription records the death and burial of Gaius Sutorius Martialis and Gaius Pinneius Crescens, who were victims of robbery.

EDCS-04001371.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. Lucius Terentius Saturninus, pious, lived for 90 years and is buried here. May the earth be light upon you.
EDCS-04001371.summary: This funerary inscription records the death and burial of Lucius Terentius Saturninus.

EDCS-04001372.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. Helvia Festiva, pious, lived for 70 years. Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. Gaius Titinius Faustinus, pious, lived for 100 years. Titinia Matrona, pious, lived...
EDCS-04001372.summary: This funerary inscription records the deaths of Helvia Festiva, Gaius Titinius Faustinus, and Titinia Matrona, with duplicate entries suggesting a complex monument.

EDCS-04001373.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Titinia Pia lived. Iulia Victoria Pia lived 90 years. Fortunata lived 9 years. Caius Titinius Iafic Pius lived 97 years. He is buried here.
EDCS-04001373.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the ages at death of Titinia Pia, Iulia Victoria Pia, Fortunata, and Caius Titinius Iafic Pius, who is buried here.

EDCS-04001374.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Lucius Titurius Festus Pius lived 21 years. He is buried here. Sacred to the departed spirits. Titurius Festus Pius lived 40 years. He lived 40 years. He is buried here. Sacred to the departed spirits. Titurius Maurus Pius lived [---] years.
EDCS-04001374.summary: This epitaph records the ages at death of Lucius Titurius Festus Pius and Titurius Festus Pius, and begins to record the age of Titurius Maurus Pius.

EDCS-04001375.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Publius Tutius Felix Pius lived 75 years. Claudia Gaetula Pia lived 65 years. Publius Tutius Victor lived 35 years. Publius Tutius Namphamo lived 25 years. Tutia Marchella Pia lived 21 years. Tutius Felix made this for himself. She is buried here.
EDCS-04001375.summary: This funerary epitaph records the ages at death of several individuals and states that Tutius Felix made it for himself.

EDCS-04001376.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Valeria Fausta Pia lived 52 years.
EDCS-04001376.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the age at death of Valeria Fausta Pia.

EDCS-04001377.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Valeria Tertulla Pia lived 70 years. She is buried here.
EDCS-04001377.summary: This funerary epitaph records the age at death of Valeria Tertulla Pia and states she is buried here.

EDCS-04001378.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Lucius Vetidius Quirina Iucundus Pius lived 70 years. He is buried here.
EDCS-04001378.summary: This funerary epitaph records the age at death of Lucius Vetidius Quirina Iucundus and states he is buried here.

EDCS-04001379.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Lucius Vettius Quirina Iucundus Pius lived 83 years. He is buried here.
EDCS-04001379.summary: This funerary epitaph records the age at death of Lucius Vettius Quirina Iucundus and states he is buried here.

EDCS-04001380.translation: To the memory of Quintus Vettius Romani Constans. He is buried here.
EDCS-04001380.summary: This is a funerary dedication for Quintus Vettius Romani Constans.

EDCS-04001381.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Quintus Vettius, son of Quintus, Quirina Saturninus Pius lived 45 years. He is buried here.
EDCS-04001381.summary: This funerary epitaph records the age at death of Quintus Vettius, son of Quintus, Quirina Saturninus, and states he is buried here.

EDCS-04001382.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Quintus Vettius, son of Quintus, Quirina Saturninus Pius lived 27 years. He is buried here.
EDCS-04001382.summary: This funerary epitaph records the age at death of Quintus Vettius, son of Quintus, Quirina Saturninus, and states he is buried here.

EDCS-04001383.translation: Sacred to the Divine Spirits. Quintus Vettius, of the Quirina tribe, pious, lived 61 years, is buried here. Sacred to the Divine Spirits. ONIIA Rustica, pious, lived 61 years, is buried here.
EDCS-04001383.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the deaths and ages of Quintus Vettius and ONIIA Rustica, likely husband and wife.

EDCS-04001384.translation: To the Divine Spirits. Vettia Blanda, pious, lived 40 years, is buried here.
EDCS-04001384.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the death and age of Vettia Blanda.

EDCS-04001385.translation: Victorianus Irianus, pious, lived 7 years, is buried here.
EDCS-04001385.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the death and age of a child, Victorianus Irianus.

EDCS-04001386.translation: Sacred to the Divine Spirits. Caecilia Fortunata, his [belonging to the deceased man mentioned previously or implied], pious, lived 55 years. Titus Vitrubius Saturninus, pious, lived 51 years, is buried here.
EDCS-04001386.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the deaths and ages of Caecilia Fortunata and Titus Vitrubius Saturninus, possibly a couple.

EDCS-04001391.summary: This is a fragmentary epitaph praising the virtues of Modestus.

EDCS-04001392.translation: Sacred to the Divine Spirits. Lucius A N, lived 100 years, is buried here.
EDCS-04001392.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the death and exceptional age of Lucius A N.

EDCS-04001394.summary: This is a fragmentary funerary epitaph recording two ages, possibly for two individuals.

EDCS-04001397.translation: Caesia Romana, pious, lived 71 years. Cominius Mercurius.
EDCS-04001397.summary: This is a fragmentary funerary epitaph mentioning Caesia Romana and Cominius Mercurius, likely recording their ages or relationship.

EDCS-04001398.translation: Pious, lived 70 years, is buried here. Pious, lived 60 years, is buried here.
EDCS-04001398.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the burial and ages of two unnamed pious individuals.

EDCS-04001399.translation: IN, of Arelius, most faithful, pious, lived 70 years.
EDCS-04001399.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the death and age of IN, described as a faithful companion or servant of Arelius.

EDCS-04001401.summary: This is a funerary inscription recording the lifespan of Cundius, who lived 60 years.

EDCS-04001405.translation: Pudens lived 51 years; he lies here.
EDCS-04001405.summary: This is a funerary inscription recording the lifespan of Pudens, who lived 51 years.

EDCS-04001406.translation: He lived 45 years; he lies here.
EDCS-04001406.summary: This is a funerary inscription recording the lifespan of an unnamed individual, who lived 45 years.

EDCS-04001407.translation: To the sacred spirits of the underworld. He lived 45 years; he lies here.
EDCS-04001407.summary: This is a funerary inscription to the underworld spirits, recording the lifespan of an unnamed individual, who lived 45 years.

EDCS-04001409.summary: This is a funerary inscription recording the lifespan of an unnamed female, who lived 15 years.

EDCS-04001410.translation: She lived 15 years; she lies here.
EDCS-04001410.summary: This is a funerary inscription recording the lifespan of an unnamed female, who lived 15 years.

EDCS-04001419.translation: Here lies Placentinus, once a blessed and now more blessed saintly bishop, who ruled the city flourishing in the Catholic faith, and now already enjoys eternal light; he lived 86 years.
EDCS-04001419.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Bishop Placentinus, who lived 86 years and was known for his rule of the city.

EDCS-04001420.translation: Maurentius, priest, lived 70 years in peace; he was buried on the fourth day before the Nones of March.
EDCS-04001420.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Maurentius, a priest, who lived 70 years and was buried on March 2nd.

EDCS-04001421.translation: Desiderius lies here, a second inhabitant of this place, born in Casas Maiores, reborn, the faithful son of Bishop Respectus; he lived 26 years in peace, buried in the first year of King Gelimer's reign, on the eleventh day before the Kalends of February.
EDCS-04001421.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Desiderius, son of Bishop Respectus, who lived 26 years and was buried in the first regnal year of King Gelimer.

EDCS-04001422.translation: Donatianus the priest, exiled for the Catholic faith, departed here in the settlement of Madauros on the Nones of April in the seventh year of Carthage; he lived 96 years.
EDCS-04001422.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Donatianus, a priest exiled for his faith, who lived 96 years and died in Madauros.

EDCS-04001423.translation: Presbyter Liberatus withdrew into exile in peace for the Catholic faith and lived 75 years; he was laid to rest on the 17th day before the Kalends of July.
EDCS-04001423.summary: This inscription records the burial of Liberatus, a presbyter, who died in exile for his Catholic faith.

EDCS-04001424.translation: In the 6th year of Carthage, on the 8th day before the Kalends of August, Flavius Anus, presbyter, servant of the Lord of the Church of Carthage, died in peace in Madauros colony, coming from Carthage; he lived faithfully for 93 years.
EDCS-04001424.summary: This inscription records the death and burial of Flavius Anus, a presbyter of Carthage, who died in the colony of Madauros.

EDCS-04001425.translation: Peregrinus, presbyter of the Catholic religion, lived 60 years.
EDCS-04001425.summary: This is a short epitaph for Peregrinus, a Catholic presbyter, stating his age at death.

EDCS-04001426.translation: In this tomb is Benezianus, deacon, who lived 35 years; he was placed here on the 14th day before the Kalends of April.
EDCS-04001426.summary: This inscription records the burial of Benezianus, a deacon, and specifies his age and date of burial.

EDCS-04001427.translation: In this tomb are buried brothers: Orus, deacon, lived 37 years, and F nus, lived [---] years, killed by the Moors, and they were buried on the Kalends of July.
EDCS-04001427.summary: This inscription records the burial of two brothers, Orus (a deacon) and F nus, noting that they were killed by the Moors.

EDCS-04001429.translation: A memorial for the veterans, the happy memory of Caecilius Aemilianus, who was recognised in his youth for his service in the Third Augustan Legion, whom honourable discharge after the labour of his bravery advanced to happy years of old age, serving the Catholic legion with the most faithful mind; he lived faithfully in peace for 83 years.
EDCS-04001429.summary: This inscription is a memorial for Caecilius Aemilianus, a veteran of the Third Augustan Legion, who served faithfully for 83 years.

EDCS-04001430.translation: Fortunata sleeps in this tomb, having followed Christ's precepts, who earned the right to raise her son to sacred mysteries and [---] other masters of life.
EDCS-04001430.summary: This epitaph records Fortunata, who followed Christian precepts and raised her son for sacred mysteries.

EDCS-04001431.translation: If you ask about the circumstances of [his] life, Flavius Victorianus Na[XXX] who, innocent, in his youth, while dutifully following his studies, [XXX] with a rivalous love, alas, piety did not grant [XXX] who, with religious affection [XXX] to place forever [XXX] the earth will cover his body S[XXX] now resting in peace, [his] parents.
EDCS-04001431.summary: A fragmentary epitaph lamenting the early death of Flavius Victorianus, suggesting a life of promise cut short by fate, likely from the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-04001432.translation: Here lies Ianuaria, who once lay here, whom I taught to teach how many mothers she made through chastity; she lived 63 years as a faithful mother, so that the name Florentinus was carried in her spirit. Sacred to the departed spirits.
EDCS-04001432.summary: This inscription is a dedication to Ianuaria, who lived 63 years, was a faithful mother, and taught chastity.

EDCS-04001434.translation: Here lies the mother, formerly a handmaid of Christ, to whom seats are given for her merits, seats which the excellent mother holds, whose very abundant deeds have spread their fame throughout all time; Mauricia Galla lived in peace for 52 years.
EDCS-04001434.summary: This epitaph records the burial of Mauricia Galla, a devout servant of Christ, who lived 52 years.

EDCS-04001436.translation: Fidelis, a most chaste virgin, buried in this tomb, resting in peace, who completed twenty-five years of life and departed to eternal light as a maiden.
EDCS-04001436.summary: This inscription records the burial of Fidelis, a chaste virgin, who died at the age of 25.

EDCS-04001437.translation: This house was dedicated to death by ancient fate; a hare took away life; he lived thirty-seven years and added [them]. Laid to rest on the third day before the Kalends of April.
EDCS-04001437.summary: This epitaph commemorates a person who died young, noting their lifespan and burial date, likely from the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-04001441.translation: The memorable name of Ilini should be remembered in verse; he established that verses should be written; the other cities bear witness to the example. He lived faithfully in peace for seventy-seven years.
EDCS-04001441.summary: This epitaph praises a man named Ilini, highlighting his virtuous life and establishing a tradition of commemorating him in verse, dating likely to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-04001442.translation: Live in God, man who lived well.
EDCS-04001442.summary: This is a short, Christian epitaph encouraging the deceased to live in God, likely from the Late Roman or Early Christian period.

EDCS-04001443.translation: Aelia Dativa Maxima lived for forty-one years, pious, patient, modest.
EDCS-04001443.summary: This epitaph records the virtues and lifespan of Aelia Dativa Maxima, likely dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-04001444.translation: Aemilius Donatus lived sixty-six years, pious, faithful; he died in peace.
EDCS-04001444.summary: This epitaph commemorates Aemilius Donatus, noting his age and virtues, likely from the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-04001445.translation: Sacred to the Divine Spirits. Aemilius Sabinus lived fifty years in peace.
EDCS-04001445.summary: This is a funerary inscription to the Divine Spirits for Aemilius Sabinus, noting his lifespan, likely from the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-04001448.translation: Sacred to the Divine Spirits. Caelius Pergulus lived eight years, three months, twenty-four days, and eight hours, pious; he is buried here in peace.
EDCS-04001448.summary: This is a funerary inscription to the Divine Spirits for Caelius Pergulus, detailing his very young age at death and burial, likely from the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-04001449.translation: Sacred to the Divine Spirits. Calpurnius Crescentio lived eighty years, pious, in peace; he is buried here.
EDCS-04001449.summary: This is a funerary inscription to the Divine Spirits for Calpurnius Crescentio, noting his age and peaceful death, likely from the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-04001450.translation: Sacred to the Divine Spirits. Celsinius Venerius lived sixty years in peace.
EDCS-04001450.summary: This is a funerary inscription to the Divine Spirits for Celsinius Venerius, noting his lifespan, likely from the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-04001451.translation: Claudia Macrunia is laid here; she lived forty-eight years in peace, faithful.
EDCS-04001451.summary: This epitaph commemorates Claudia Macrunia, noting her lifespan and virtues, likely from the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-04001452.translation: Fabricia Faustiniana, faithful, lived in peace for 47 years and 23 days.
EDCS-04001452.summary: This inscription records the lifespan of Fabricia Faustiniana, a Christian woman.

EDCS-04001453.translation: Flavius Asterius, faithful, lived in peace for 50 years.
EDCS-04001453.summary: This inscription records the lifespan of Flavius Asterius, a Christian man.

EDCS-04001454.translation: Flavius Aventius, faithful, lived in peace for 40 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-04001454.summary: This inscription records the burial of Flavius Aventius, a Christian man.

EDCS-04001455.translation: Flavius Petronianus, faithful always, lived in peace for 65 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-04001455.summary: This inscription records the burial of Flavius Petronianus, a Christian man.

EDCS-04001457.translation: Flavia Fortunata, innocent, faithful, lived in peace for 4 years.
EDCS-04001457.summary: This inscription records the lifespan of Flavia Fortunata, a young Christian girl.

EDCS-04001458.translation: Sacred to the Divine Manes. Gallius Victorinus, dutiful and happy, lived in peace for 65 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-04001458.summary: This inscription records the burial of Gallius Victorinus, a man who lived to 65.

EDCS-04001459.translation: Uglatius, placed here, faithful, lived for 75 years. Placed on the 10th day before the Ides of March.
EDCS-04001459.summary: This inscription records the burial of Uglatius, who died on March 5th.

EDCS-04001460.translation: In this tomb Isas was placed. Lived for 65 years. Placed on the 21st day before the Kalends of January.
EDCS-04001460.summary: This inscription records the burial of Isas, who died on December 12th.

EDCS-04001461.translation: Iulius Cresconius, faithful, lived for 26 years. Placed on the 2nd day before the Kalends of January, in the peace of Christ.
EDCS-04001461.summary: This inscription records the burial of Iulius Cresconius, a young Christian man.

EDCS-04001462.translation: Iulius Donatus, faithful, lived in peace for 50 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-04001462.summary: This inscription records the burial of Iulius Donatus, a Christian man.

EDCS-04001464.translation: Julia Afrodite lived faithfully in peace for 18 years.
EDCS-04001464.summary: A tombstone recording the lifespan of Julia Afrodite, who lived faithfully in peace for 18 years.

EDCS-04001465.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Julia Dativa lived for 60 years, pious in peace, and Calpurnia Kassuntina, innocent, lived for 15 years, pious in peace; she is laid here.
EDCS-04001465.summary: A tombstone dedicated to the departed spirits, recording the lives of Julia Dativa and Calpurnia Kassuntina, noting their piety and innocence.

EDCS-04001466.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Julia Meggent, faithful in peace, lived for 66 years; she is laid here.
EDCS-04001466.summary: A tombstone dedicated to the departed spirits, recording the life of Julia Meggent, who lived faithfully for 66 years.

EDCS-04001467.translation: Julia Victoria lived faithfully in peace for 44 years, laid to rest on the fourth day before the Kalends of January.
EDCS-04001467.summary: A tombstone recording the lifespan and burial date of Julia Victoria, who lived faithfully for 44 years.

EDCS-04001468.translation: Servilius Primulianus, pious and most innocent, lived for six years; he is laid here. Servilia Optata, pious and most innocent woman, lived for [---] years; she is laid here.
EDCS-04001468.summary: A tombstone for Servilius Primulianus and Servilia Optata, noting their piety and innocence and their lifespans.

EDCS-04001469.translation: lius Servilianus, faithful in peace, lived for 83 years, laid to rest on the ninth day before the Kalends of September; he is laid here.
EDCS-04001469.summary: A tombstone recording the lifespan and burial date of Servilianus, who lived faithfully for 83 years.

EDCS-04001470.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. guta, pious and faithful, lived in peace for 42 years; she is laid here.
EDCS-04001470.summary: A tombstone dedicated to the departed spirits, recording the life of guta, who lived piously and faithfully for 42 years.

EDCS-04001472.translation: NTO Iunior, faithful in peace, lived for [---] years.
EDCS-04001472.summary: A tombstone fragment recording the lifespan of NTO Iunior, who lived faithfully for an unspecified number of years.

EDCS-04001473.translation: A younger brother made this tomb for his elder.
EDCS-04001473.summary: An epitaph recording that a younger brother commissioned a tomb for his elder brother.

EDCS-04001478.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. The young man Furius Crescentius lived for 22 years.
EDCS-04001478.summary: A tombstone dedicated to the departed spirits, recording the lifespan of the young Furius Crescentius.

EDCS-04001491.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Gaius Felicionis lived for 50 years.
EDCS-04001491.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the lifespan of Gaius Felicionis, likely dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-04001492.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Lucius Iulius Vi lived for 40 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-04001492.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the lifespan and burial of Lucius Iulius Vi, likely dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-04001493.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Urbana the pious lived for 34 years; she is buried here. Syntrophus for his most holy wife.
EDCS-04001493.summary: This is a funerary epitaph set up by Syntrophus for his wife Urbana, recording her lifespan and likely dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-04001496.translation: Sacred to Mars Augustus. Lucius Pontius undertook the construction of an altar to Mars at his own expense and dedicated it himself.
EDCS-04001496.summary: This is a dedication to Mars Augustus by Lucius Pontius, who funded and dedicated an altar, likely dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-04001497.summary: This is a simple dedication or maker's inscription by Titus Aelius Seleucus, likely dating to the Roman Imperial period.
