EDCS-13002699.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Curiatius Festus Tabonianus, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002700.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Quintus Eggrilius lived 23 years.
EDCS-13002700.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Quintus Eggrilius, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002701.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Quintus Fabius Victorinus Volussianus, dutiful, lived 30 years. May your bones rest well. May the earth lie lightly upon you.
EDCS-13002701.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Quintus Fabius Victorinus Volussianus, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002702.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. F. Matrona, dutiful, lived 60 years. She lies here.
EDCS-13002702.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for F. Matrona, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002703.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Fannius Marinus lived 3 years. May your bones rest well.
EDCS-13002703.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Fannius Marinus, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002704.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Ius Felix Crescentianus, dutiful, lived 15 years. May your bones rest well. May the earth lie lightly upon you.
EDCS-13002704.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Ius Felix Crescentianus, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002705.translation: Tius Fortunatus lived 25 years. May your bones rest well.
EDCS-13002705.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Tius Fortunatus, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002706.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Quintus Gargilius Felix, dutiful, lived 81 years. May your bones rest well.
EDCS-13002706.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Quintus Gargilius Felix, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002707.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Gargilia Saturnina, dutiful, lived [unknown] years. May your bones rest well. May the earth lie lightly upon you.
EDCS-13002707.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Gargilia Saturnina, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002708.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Gemella, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002709.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Gaius Haranus Marinus, dutiful, lived for 6 years. May the earth be light upon you.
EDCS-13002709.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Gaius Haranus Marinus, recording his age at death and a wish for peace.

EDCS-13002710.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Honorata, dutiful daughter of Primus, lived for 25 years. May your bones rest well.
EDCS-13002710.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Honorata, daughter of Primus, stating her age at death and a wish for peace.

EDCS-13002711.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Iulia Flacchilla, dutiful, lived for 5 years. She is laid here.
EDCS-13002711.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Iulia Flacchilla, recording her age at death and that she is buried here.

EDCS-13002712.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Iulia Matrona, dutiful, lived for [...] years.
EDCS-13002712.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Iulia Matrona, recording her name and an incomplete lifespan.

EDCS-13002714.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Magnia Clodia Marciana Flaviana, dutiful daughter of Lucius, lived for 5 years and eight months. May your bones rest well. May the earth be light upon you.
EDCS-13002714.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Magnia Clodia Marciana Flaviana, detailing her age at death and expressing wishes for peace.

EDCS-13002715.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. QUARIAN ISNAM lived for [...] years.
EDCS-13002715.summary: This is a funerary epitaph with an incomplete name and lifespan for a person named Quarian Isnam.

EDCS-13002716.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Silius Ianuarius lived for 80 years. H P O.
EDCS-13002716.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Silius Ianuarius, recording his age at death and an abbreviation of uncertain meaning.

EDCS-13002717.translation: Gaius Sittius Felix, dutiful, lived for 60 years. May your bones rest well. May the earth be light upon you.
EDCS-13002717.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Gaius Sittius Felix, stating his age at death and expressing wishes for peace.

EDCS-13002718.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Statius Mustiolus, dutiful, lived for 40 years.
EDCS-13002718.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Statius Mustiolus, recording his age at death.

EDCS-13002719.translation: Titinia Secunda, dutiful, lived for 25 years. May she rest well here.
EDCS-13002719.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Titinia Secunda, recording her age at death and a wish for eternal rest.

EDCS-13002720.translation: LI RON lived 75 years. May your bones rest well. May the earth lie lightly upon you. 95.
EDCS-13002720.summary: This is a funerary inscription for LI RON, stating her age at death and including wishes for her repose.

EDCS-13002721.summary: This is a brief funerary inscription for L. Pius, recording his lifespan.

EDCS-13002722.translation: Candidianus the swineherd lived 50 years, 6 months, and 13 days in peace.
EDCS-13002722.summary: This funerary inscription records the lifespan of Candidianus, identified as a swineherd.

EDCS-13002723.translation: Scribonius lived 6 days before the Ides of October.
EDCS-13002723.summary: This inscription, likely funerary, records the short lifespan of Scribonius.

EDCS-13002725.translation: To Iocolon, the ancestral god. Marcus Mevius Romanus, companion of our Augustus, an outstanding man.
EDCS-13002725.summary: This is a dedication to the god Iocolon by Marcus Mevius Romanus, who held the high-ranking position of comes Augusti.

EDCS-13002726.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Marcus Mevius Romanus, perpetual priest, pious, lived 90 years.
EDCS-13002726.summary: This funerary inscription honors Marcus Mevius Romanus, a perpetual priest, and records his age at death.

EDCS-13002727.translation: O ANEA, pontifex, consecrated this place, aged 17 years.
EDCS-13002727.summary: This inscription records the consecration of a place by ANEA, a pontifex, at the age of 17.

EDCS-13002728.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Publius Aelius Modestus Rogatianus, pious, lived 25 years and some months. He rests here.
EDCS-13002728.summary: This funerary inscription records the age of death (25 years) of Publius Aelius Modestus Rogatianus.

EDCS-13002729.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Iulia Iunonia lived 73 years. She rests here. Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Bursius Saturninus lived 81 years. He rests here.
EDCS-13002729.summary: This is a double funerary inscription recording the ages at death of Iulia Iunonia (73) and Bursius Saturninus (81).

EDCS-13002730.translation: Burius M. [son], lived 30 years. Sacred to the spirits of the departed. NERM LICA, pious, lived 50 years. She is buried here. Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Caius Buius Venustus, pious, lived 60 years. He is here.
EDCS-13002730.summary: This inscription contains three funerary notices for Burius M. [son] (30), NERM LICA (50), and Caius Buius Venustus (60).

EDCS-13002731.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Marcus Caledius Achilleus, dutiful, lived 95 years, is buried here. Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Valeria Maura lived 60 years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002731.summary: A funerary inscription recording the deaths of Marcus Caledius Achilleus and Valeria Maura, with their ages at death.

EDCS-13002732.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Calpurnius Vicentius lived 35 years.
EDCS-13002732.summary: A funerary inscription recording the death of Calpurnius Vicentius, with his age at death.

EDCS-13002733.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Clodia lived 21 years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002733.summary: A funerary inscription recording the death of Clodia, with her age at death.

EDCS-13002734.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Festa lived 45 years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002734.summary: A funerary inscription recording the death of Festa, with her age at death.

EDCS-13002735.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Furnius Felix lived 90 years.
EDCS-13002735.summary: A funerary inscription recording the death of Furnius Felix, with his age at death.

EDCS-13002736.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Sentia Saturnina lived 65 years, her body is here before. Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Decimus Gargilius Gargilianus lived 68 years, his body is here before.
EDCS-13002736.summary: A funerary inscription recording the deaths of Sentia Saturnina and Decimus Gargilius Gargilianus, with their ages at death.

EDCS-13002737.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Postumia Saturnina, dutiful, lived 25 years, is buried here. Caius Iunius Tuticus lived 3 years, is buried here. Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Caius Iunius Statianus lived 23 years, is buried here. Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Quintus Iunius Salginus lived 85 years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002737.summary: A funerary inscription recording the deaths of Postumia Saturnina, Caius Iunius Tuticus, Caius Iunius Statianus, and Quintus Iunius Salginus, with their ages at death.

EDCS-13002738.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Iulia Rogata, daughter, lived 60 years, is buried here. Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Marcus Petronius Victor, dutiful, lived 47 years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002738.summary: A funerary inscription recording the deaths of Iulia Rogata and Marcus Petronius Victor, with their ages at death.

EDCS-13002739.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Rerius Maximus lived 101 years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002739.summary: A funerary inscription recording the death of Rerius Maximus, with his age at death.

EDCS-13002740.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Neratia Festa lived 70 years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002740.summary: A funerary inscription recording the death of Neratia Festa, with her age at death.

EDCS-13002741.summary: This funerary inscription records the lifespan of Publius Casius.

EDCS-13002742.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Pacata, wife of Urbicus, lived for 7 years.
EDCS-13002742.summary: This funerary inscription records the death of Pacata, daughter of Urbicus, who died at the age of 7.

EDCS-13002743.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Caius Pacuntius Surus, dutiful, lived for 42 years and is buried here. Sacred to the departed spirits. Caius Acvitivs Inventus, dutiful, lived for 42 years and is buried here. Frumentia made this.
EDCS-13002743.summary: This funerary inscription records the deaths of Caius Pacuntius Surus and Caius Acvitivs Inventus, both dying at 42, and was made by Frumentia.

EDCS-13002744.translation: For years. Sacred to the departed spirits. Pia lived for [X] years and is buried here. Sacred to the departed spirits. Caius Rutilius Victor.
EDCS-13002744.summary: This funerary inscription records the burial of Pia and mentions Caius Rutilius Victor, likely a relative.

EDCS-13002747.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. [Name illegible] lived for 17 years.
EDCS-13002747.summary: This funerary inscription records the lifespan of an individual whose name is illegible.

EDCS-13002748.translation: On the 3rd day before the Kalends of December, Servuca, a cleric, died, reaching her end at the age of 100.
EDCS-13002748.summary: This funerary inscription records the death of Servuca, a cleric, at the age of 100.

EDCS-13002749.translation: Presbyter on the day before the Nones of September.
EDCS-13002749.summary: This fragmentary inscription mentions a presbyter and a date, likely related to an ecclesiastical event.

EDCS-13002751.summary: This funerary inscription records the short lifespan of a child named Serbulus.

EDCS-13002754.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Annaea Vennusta lived for 85 years and is buried here.
EDCS-13002754.summary: This funerary inscription records the death and burial of Annaea Vennusta at the age of 85.

EDCS-13002755.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Caecilius [Name illegible] lived for 55 years.
EDCS-13002755.summary: This funerary inscription records the lifespan of Caecilius, with an illegible second name.

EDCS-13002756.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Virius Laricha lived 86 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13002756.summary: A funerary inscription recording the age and burial place of Virius Laricha, dedicated to the Spirits of the Departed.

EDCS-13002757.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Volussia Flora, daughter of Marcus, lived 70 years.
EDCS-13002757.summary: A funerary inscription recording the age of Volussia Flora, daughter of Marcus, dedicated to the Spirits of the Departed.

EDCS-13002759.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Caius Clodia, 15 years old.
EDCS-13002759.summary: A funerary inscription recording the age of Caius Clodia, dedicated to the Spirits of the Departed.

EDCS-13002761.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Silicius Secundus, pious, lived 60 years. Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Silicius Felix, pious, lived 25 years. Antilia Victorica made this for her son and husband.
EDCS-13002761.summary: A funerary inscription recording the ages of Silicius Secundus and Silicius Felix, with Antilia Victorica dedicating it to her son and husband, honoring the Spirits of the Departed.

EDCS-13002763.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Ianuaria Baribgalis, daughter of Baribgalis, lived 55 years. Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Garicius Martialis lived 75 years and 3 months.
EDCS-13002763.summary: A funerary inscription recording the ages of Ianuaria Baribgalis and Garicius Martialis, dedicated to the Spirits of the Departed.

EDCS-13002766.translation: Quinti Postimi lived 75 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13002766.summary: A funerary inscription recording the age and burial place of Quinti Postimi.

EDCS-13002767.translation: Caius Geminius Valens lived 65 years; pious.
EDCS-13002767.summary: A funerary inscription recording the age and piety of Caius Geminius Valens.

EDCS-13002768.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Herennius Honoratus, pious, lived 80 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13002768.summary: A funerary inscription recording the age and burial place of Herennius Honoratus, dedicated to the Spirits of the Departed.

EDCS-13002769.translation: SELAVCHA, daughter of THELVERAE, pious, lived 40 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-13002769.summary: A funerary inscription recording the age and burial place of SELAVCHA, daughter of THELVERAE.

EDCS-13002770.translation: Sacred to Caelestis Augusta. Caecilius Victor has repaid the vow which he promised.
EDCS-13002770.summary: A votive inscription recording Caecilius Victor repaying a vow made to Caelestis Augusta.

EDCS-13002771.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Hortensia Casta, dutiful, lived 75 years. Caius Iulius Valerianus, priest of Saturn, made this for himself and his wife.
EDCS-13002771.summary: A tombstone dedicated to Hortensia Casta by her husband, Caius Iulius Valerianus, a priest of Saturn, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002773.translation: During the reign of Emperor Nerva Caesar Augustus. Sacred to Victoriae Augustae. Lucius Granius Honoratus, son of Lucius, of the Quirina tribe, soldier of the III Augusta legion, century of Marcus Antonius, had this built at his own expense upon completing his term as decurion.
EDCS-13002773.summary: An inscription from the reign of Emperor Nerva recording the dedication of a monument by Lucius Granius Honoratus, a soldier of the III Augusta legion, for his service as a decurion.

EDCS-13002775.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Marcus Castricius Severus, dutiful priest of Jupiter, lived 93 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13002775.summary: A tombstone recording the death of Marcus Castricius Severus, a priest of Jupiter, likely dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002777.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Caius Iulius Baric, dutiful, lived 86 years. Caius Iulius Castus, dutiful, lived 42 years. Iulia Victoria, dutiful, lived 110 years. Caius Iulius Dontius, dutiful, lived 45 years; he is buried here. Caius Iulius Victorinus, the tester, made this for his parents.
EDCS-13002777.summary: A tombstone for multiple family members, including Caius Iulius Baric, Caius Iulius Castus, Iulia Victoria, and Caius Iulius Dontius, with Caius Iulius Victorinus as the maker, from the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002778.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. A Monna, dutiful, lived [---] years; she is buried here.
EDCS-13002778.summary: A tombstone recording the death of A Monna, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002780.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Titus Antonius Supernus, dutiful, lived 25 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13002780.summary: A tombstone recording the death of Titus Antonius Supernus, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002782.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Avia Matunis lived 30 years.
EDCS-13002782.summary: A tombstone recording the death of Avia Matunis, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002784.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Tiberius Claudius Narcissus, dutiful, lived 60 years. Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Eutychia, dutiful, lived 57 years.
EDCS-13002784.summary: A tombstone likely for two individuals, Tiberius Claudius Narcissus and Eutychia, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002785.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Marcus Cornelius Fortunatus, dutiful, lived 85 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13002785.summary: A tombstone recording the death of Marcus Cornelius Fortunatus, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002786.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Lucius Fabricius Saturninus Felicianus, dutiful, lived 8 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13002786.summary: A tombstone recording the death of Lucius Fabricius Saturninus Felicianus, likely a child, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002787.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Bennia Data, dutiful, lived 85 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-13002787.summary: A tombstone recording the death of Bennia Data, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002788.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Fannia Matrona lived 105 years.
EDCS-13002788.summary: A funerary epitaph recording the lifespan of Fannia Matrona, likely from the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002789.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Iulius Calvus, pious, lived 36 years and 5 months.
EDCS-13002789.summary: A funerary epitaph recording the lifespan of Iulius Calvus, likely from the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002790.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Publius Iulius Firmus, son of Firmus, pious, lived 4 years. He rests here.
EDCS-13002790.summary: A funerary epitaph recording the lifespan and burial place of a young child, Publius Iulius Firmus.

EDCS-13002791.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Caius Iulius Tertius, son of Caius Iulius Natus, lived 7 years.
EDCS-13002791.summary: A funerary epitaph recording the lifespan of Caius Iulius Tertius, likely from the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002792.translation: Iulia Quarta, daughter of Publius, pious, lived 50 years. She rests here.
EDCS-13002792.summary: A funerary epitaph recording the lifespan and burial place of Iulia Quarta, likely from the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002793.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Iulia Rogata, pious, lived 65 years. She rests here.
EDCS-13002793.summary: A funerary epitaph recording the lifespan and burial place of Iulia Rogata, likely from the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002794.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Iulia Victoria lived 71 years. She rests here.
EDCS-13002794.summary: A funerary epitaph recording the lifespan and burial place of Iulia Victoria, likely from the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002795.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Publius Licinius Venuleius, pious, lived 85 years. He rests here. Grasidia Saturnina, pious, lived 45 years. She rests here.
EDCS-13002795.summary: A double funerary epitaph recording the lifespans and burial places of Publius Licinius Venuleius and Grasidia Saturnina.

EDCS-13002796.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Mizguar, son of Baricis, pious, lived 31 years. He rests here.
EDCS-13002796.summary: A funerary epitaph recording the lifespan and burial place of Mizguar, son of Baricis, likely from the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002797.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Caius Marius Romanus, pious, lived 70 years. He rests here. Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Iulia Maxima, pious, lived 71 years. Caius Marius Romanus the younger, pious, lived...
EDCS-13002797.summary: A fragmented funerary epitaph likely recording the lifespans and burial places of Caius Marius Romanus, Iulia Maxima, and Caius Marius Romanus the younger.

EDCS-13002798.translation: Pompeius Honaratus and Pompeia Fortunata, daughter of Gaius Pompeius Vit, have erected a statue at their own expense to perpetuate the memory of Pompeius Honaratus.
EDCS-13002798.summary: This is a funerary inscription recording the erection of a statue by Pompeia Fortunata for the memory of Pompeius Honaratus, likely a private monument.

EDCS-13002799.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Pompeia Regilla lived 93 years. Tiberius Claudius Loquella lived 4 years. Tiberius Claudius Novellus lived 6 years.
EDCS-13002799.summary: This is a funerary inscription recording the ages at death of three individuals: Pompeia Regilla, Tiberius Claudius Loquella, and Tiberius Claudius Novellus, likely from the same family.

EDCS-13002800.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Lucius Sallustius Firmianus, dutiful, lived 60 years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002800.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Lucius Sallustius Firmianus, stating his age and that he is buried here.

EDCS-13002801.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Lucius Verulanius Fortis, buried here, lived 35 years.
EDCS-13002801.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Lucius Verulanius Fortis, stating his age and that he is buried here.

EDCS-13002802.translation: C. M. V. Risivs lived 90 years.
EDCS-13002802.summary: This is a funerary inscription recording the age at death of an individual identified as C. M. V. Risivs.

EDCS-13002804.translation: Flavius Urbanus lived 58 years in peace. Iulia Crescentia lived 52 years. They departed this life on the same day.
EDCS-13002804.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Flavius Urbanus and Iulia Crescentia, who died on the same day and had lived for 58 and 52 years respectively.

EDCS-13002808.translation: Marcus Terentius Victor, a veteran, lived 75 years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002808.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Marcus Terentius Victor, a veteran, stating his age and that he is buried here.

EDCS-13002809.translation: Fortunatus' son, a Roman citizen, dutiful, lived 15 years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002809.summary: This is a funerary inscription for the son of Fortunatus, a Roman citizen, stating his age and that he is buried here.

EDCS-13002810.translation: Marcus Iulius Novellus erected this for his most devoted and rarest wife, Iulia Romula, who lived 50 years. Also for his most devoted and rarest daughter, Iulia Victoria, who lived 31 years. And for himself, Marcus Iulius Novellus, who obtained Roman citizenship, served as a decurion, aedile, prefect of justice, and duovir, and lived 70 years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002810.summary: This is a large funerary inscription set up by Marcus Iulius Novellus for his wife, daughter, and himself, detailing his own significant public career and the ages at death of all three.

EDCS-13002811.translation: Mutthun, son of Victor, priest of Caelestis, lived 90 years, is buried here. May your bones rest well.
EDCS-13002811.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Mutthun, son of Victor, a priest of Caelestis, stating his age and including a wish for his repose.

EDCS-13002812.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Lucius Sallustius Victor, having obtained Roman citizenship, pious, lived 21 years, is buried here. Lucius Sallustius Rogatianus, pious, lived 21 years, is buried here. Caecilia Festiva, also called Leda, wife of Lucius Sallustius Victor, pious, lived 45 years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002812.summary: A funerary inscription for Lucius Sallustius Rogatianus, his wife Caecilia Festiva, and potentially his father Lucius Sallustius Victor, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002813.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Fortunata, daughter of Rogatus, wife of Crescens, pious, lived 53 years, is buried here. Julius Crescens, son of Firmus, a baker, pious.
EDCS-13002813.summary: A funerary inscription for Fortunata and her husband Julius Crescens, a baker, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002814.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Memmia Axonnia, daughter of Varthigalis, wife of Acasan, pious, lived [---] years. Acasan, son of Baliathon, son of Baliathon, pious, lived 80 years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002814.summary: A funerary inscription for Acasan and his wife Memmia Axonnia, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002815.translation: Amotbal, son of Saturninus, Julius MA VI, pious, lived 100 years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002815.summary: A funerary inscription for Amotbal Saturninus, who lived to be 100 years old, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002817.translation: Quintus Aufidius Saturninus lived 80 years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002817.summary: A funerary inscription for Quintus Aufidius Saturninus, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002818.translation: Gabinia Iulia [---] son of Baricus, who is also called Musa, lived 81 years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002818.summary: A funerary inscription for Gabinia Iulia, also known as Musa, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002819.summary: A funerary inscription for Aurelia, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002820.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Iulia Bellica, wife of Baebius Victor, lived 61 years. Decimus Baebius Victor, son of Baebius Maximus, lived [---] years. Baebius Saturus, son of Victor, pious, lived 25 years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002820.summary: A funerary inscription for members of the Baebius family, including Iulia Bellica, Decimus Baebius Victor, and Baebius Saturus, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002821.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Caius Baebius Maximianus, pious, lived 53 years, is buried here. Iulia Caesonia, pious, lived [---] years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002821.summary: A funerary inscription for Caius Baebius Maximianus and Iulia Caesonia, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002822.translation: Baebia Eudemosine lived 40 years; her husband set this up; she is buried here.
EDCS-13002822.summary: A funerary inscription for Baebia Eudemosine, erected by her husband, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13002823.translation: Iulia Pacata lived 85 years, she is buried here. P.E. Paca the pious lived 35 years, he is buried here.
EDCS-13002823.summary: This inscription records the burial of Iulia Pacata and P.E. Paca, likely a couple.

EDCS-13002824.translation: Balibal, son of Isstatanis, from Namphamo, son of Balibal, lived 23 years, he is buried here. Balibal the pious lived...
EDCS-13002824.summary: This inscription records the burial of Balibal, son of Isstatanis, and mentions another Balibal, likely his father.

EDCS-13002825.translation: Biricbal lived 101 years. Baricbal, son of Marchellus, lived 67 years, he is buried here.
EDCS-13002825.summary: This inscription records the burial of Biricbal and Baricbal, son of Marchellus, likely father and son.

EDCS-13002826.translation: Baricbal, son of Severus, lived 85 years, he is buried here. Baebia Rogata the pious lived 101 years, she is buried here.
EDCS-13002826.summary: This inscription records the burial of Baricbal, son of Severus, and Baebia Rogata, likely a married couple.

EDCS-13002827.translation: Berecbal, son of Barbatus, lived 55 years. Saturus, son of Quintus, the pious, lived 85 years, he is buried here.
EDCS-13002827.summary: This inscription records the burial of Berecbal, son of Barbatus, and Saturus, son of Quintus.

EDCS-13002828.translation: Spes, daughter of Caecilius Proculus, the pious, lived 12 years and 6 months, she is buried here.
EDCS-13002828.summary: This inscription records the burial of Spes, daughter of Caecilius Proculus.

EDCS-13002829.translation: To the departed spirits. Caecilia DIA.
EDCS-13002829.summary: This inscription is a dedication to the departed spirits, likely for Caecilia.

EDCS-13002830.translation: Gaius Calpurnius Silvanus the pious lived 85 years, he is buried here.
EDCS-13002830.summary: This inscription records the burial of Gaius Calpurnius Silvanus.

EDCS-13002831.translation: Casta, wife of Castus, lived 65 years, she is buried here. Castus, son of Rufus.
EDCS-13002831.summary: This inscription records the burial of Casta, wife of Castus, and mentions Castus, son of Rufus.

EDCS-13002832.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Fabricia Fortunata, wife of Celsinus, the pious, lived. Celsinus, son of Urbanus, the pious, lived 73 years. Evasia, daughter of Celsinus, the pious, lived 15 years, she is buried here.
EDCS-13002832.summary: This inscription is a dedication to the departed spirits and records the burials of Fabricia Fortunata, her husband Celsinus, and their daughter Evasia.

EDCS-13002833.translation: Ceresces Peculiaris, son, lived 30 years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002833.summary: This is a tombstone inscription for Ceresces Peculiaris, who lived 30 years.

EDCS-13002834.translation: Chirtisis, 31 years. A. P. Urbana, wife of Chirtisis.
EDCS-13002834.summary: This inscription records the ages of Chirtisis (31) and A. P. Urbana, his wife.

EDCS-13002835.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Sabina, wife of Cornelius, lived 90 years. C. N. I. Cornelius, lived 70 years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002835.summary: This tombstone honors Sabina and C. N. I. Cornelius, specifying their ages at death and that Cornelius is buried there.

EDCS-13002836.translation: Nampame, daughter of Saturninus, lived 85 years, is buried here. Caius Cornelius Saturninus, lived 50 years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002836.summary: This tombstone records the burials and lifespans of Nampame and Caius Cornelius Saturninus.

EDCS-13002837.translation: Cultorius Mustulus lived 60 years, is buried here. Victoria, wife of Mustulus, lived 60 years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002837.summary: This tombstone inscription marks the burial place and ages of Cultorius Mustulus and his wife Victoria.

EDCS-13002838.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Marcus Aurelius Diadumenus lived 45 years, is buried in this place.
EDCS-13002838.summary: This funerary inscription records the burial of Marcus Aurelius Diadumenus, who lived 45 years.

EDCS-13002839.translation: Domitius Venustus, dutiful, lived 41 years, is buried here. Domitius Optatus, dutiful, lived 21 years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002839.summary: This tombstone records the burial and ages of Domitius Venustus and Domitius Optatus.

EDCS-13002840.summary: This inscription likely commemorates Quintus Flavius Saturninus and Iulia Matrona, possibly as a married couple.

EDCS-13002841.translation: Flavia Urbana Romani, dutiful, lived 60 years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002841.summary: This tombstone inscription records the burial and lifespan of Flavia Urbana Romani.

EDCS-13002842.translation: lived [xx] years, is buried here. Florida, wife of Rufi, dutiful, lived 71 years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002842.summary: This inscription marks the burial place and age of Florida, wife of Rufi, and also mentions another person whose lifespan is lost.

EDCS-13002843.summary: This inscription identifies Fortunata by her father and grandfather's names, likely part of a funerary monument.

EDCS-13002844.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Gaetula OIN.
EDCS-13002844.summary: This is a funerary dedication to the Divine Shades for Gaetula, whose name is partially garbled.

EDCS-13002845.translation: Crescentia, daughter of Saturninus, lived 35 years, is buried here. Gemellus, son of Felix, lived 40 years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002845.summary: This inscription records the burial of two individuals, Crescentia and Gemellus, along with their ages at death.

EDCS-13002846.translation: Hilarus, son of Primulus, dutiful, lived 30 years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002846.summary: This inscription is a funerary epitaph for Hilarus, stating his age at death and filial piety.

EDCS-13002847.summary: This inscription records the lifespan of Quintus Icilius Paulus, likely from a tombstone.

EDCS-13002848.translation: Biricutati, daughter of [---], lived [---] years. Iulius I, dutiful, lived [---] years.
EDCS-13002848.summary: This inscription appears to be a fragmented funerary epitaph, possibly mentioning two individuals and their ages.

EDCS-13002849.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Iulius Genti lived 60 years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002849.summary: This is a funerary dedication to the Divine Shades for Iulius Genti, stating his age at death.

EDCS-13002850.translation: Iulius Veri, son of Verus, lived 35 years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002850.summary: This funerary epitaph records the burial of Iulius Veri, son of Verus, and his age at death.

EDCS-13002852.summary: This inscription is a funerary epitaph for Iulius Castrensis, mentioning his piety and incomplete age.

EDCS-13002853.translation: Iulius Catullinus, son of Victor, Iulius Victor, son of Victor.
EDCS-13002853.summary: This inscription records the names and parentage of two individuals, Iulius Catullinus and Iulius Victor, possibly related to a family tomb.

EDCS-13002854.translation: Julius Crescens, pious, lived 85 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13002854.summary: This is a tomb inscription recording the life and burial of Julius Crescens.

EDCS-13002855.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Julius Faustianus, son of Marcus Julius Fronto, pious, lived 20 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13002855.summary: This tomb inscription records the burial of Julius Faustianus, son of Marcus Julius Fronto.

EDCS-13002856.translation: Julius Felix, son of Julius Rogatus, pious, lived 32 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13002856.summary: This tomb inscription records the burial of Julius Felix, son of Julius Rogatus.

EDCS-13002857.translation: Lucius Julius Flacchus, pious, lived 75 years; Seia Pacata, wife of Julius Flacchus, lived 91 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-13002857.summary: This tomb inscription records the lives and burials of Lucius Julius Flacchus and his wife Seia Pacata.

EDCS-13002858.translation: Fructus, son of Repentinus, pious, lived 50 years; he is buried here. Julia Matrona, wife of Julius Fructus, lived 50 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-13002858.summary: This tomb inscription records the lives and burials of Fructus and his wife Julia Matrona.

EDCS-13002859.summary: This is a funerary inscription recording the lifespan of Julius Honoratus.

EDCS-13002860.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Maurus, son of Felix, lived 65 years. Julius Honoratus and his wife Saturnina.
EDCS-13002860.summary: This funerary inscription records the lifespans of Maurus and Julius Honoratus and mentions his wife Saturnina.

EDCS-13002861.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. For Dativa Primuli, his pious wife, who lived 40 years; she is buried here. Julius Honoratus Victorinus, her pious husband.
EDCS-13002861.summary: This tomb inscription records the burial of Dativa Primuli and mentions her husband Julius Honoratus Victorinus.

EDCS-13002862.translation: Here lies Lucius Julius Ianuarius, pious, lived 81 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13002862.summary: This tomb inscription records the burial of Lucius Julius Ianuarius.

EDCS-13002863.translation: Grania Saturnina, pious. Quintus Julius Nundinarius.
EDCS-13002863.summary: This inscription likely records the names of Grania Saturnina and Quintus Julius Nundinarius, possibly related to a funerary monument.

EDCS-13002864.translation: Wife of Iulius Pacatus lived 40 years, here he lies. Quintus Iulius Pacatus, son of Iulius Pacatus, lived 10 years, here he lies. Quintus Iulius Pacatus lived 55 years, here he lies. Caius Iulius Gemellus, son of Iulius Pacatus, dutiful, lived 20 years, here he lies.
EDCS-13002864.summary: This funerary inscription records the burials of several members of the Iulius family, including Quintus Iulius Pacatus and his son Caius Iulius Gemellus.

EDCS-13002865.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Marcus Iulius Victor, son of Felix, dutiful, lived 17 years, here he lies.
EDCS-13002865.summary: This is a funerary inscription dedicated to the gods of the underworld for Marcus Iulius Victor, son of Felix.

EDCS-13002866.translation: Marcus Iulius Vitalis lived 70 years, here he lies. Iulia Honorata, daughter of Barbarus, dutiful, lived 85 years. Marcus Iulius Barbarus lived 23 years, here he lies.
EDCS-13002866.summary: This funerary inscription records the ages at death of Marcus Iulius Vitalis, Iulia Honorata, and Marcus Iulius Barbarus.

EDCS-13002867.translation: Iulia lived 10 years, here she lies.
EDCS-13002867.summary: A brief funerary inscription for a young girl named Iulia.

EDCS-13002868.translation: Iulia Arisi lived 40 years, here she lies.
EDCS-13002868.summary: This funerary inscription records the death of Iulia Arisi.

EDCS-13002869.translation: Iulia, daughter of Iulius, lived 80 years.
EDCS-13002869.summary: This inscription records the lifespan of Iulia, daughter of Iulius.

EDCS-13002870.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Iulia Biric, daughter of Felix, dutiful, lived 75 years, here she lies. Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Baric, son of Baricion, lived X years, here he lies.
EDCS-13002870.summary: This funerary inscription records the burial of Iulia Biric and Baric, son of Baricion, likely from the same family.

EDCS-13002871.translation: Quintus, son of Dextrius, dutiful, lived 87 years. Iulia Rogati, daughter of Rogatus, dutiful, lived 101 years, here she lies.
EDCS-13002871.summary: This funerary inscription commemorates Quintus, son of Dextrius, and Iulia Rogati, daughter of Rogatus.

EDCS-13002872.translation: Iulia Cala, daughter of Caius, lived 25 years, here she lies.
EDCS-13002872.summary: This funerary inscription records the burial of Iulia Cala, daughter of Caius.

EDCS-13002873.translation: Iulia Ianuaria, daughter of Honoratus and Euticus, lived 81 years, here she lies.
EDCS-13002873.summary: This funerary inscription records the burial of Iulia Ianuaria, daughter of Honoratus and Euticus.

EDCS-13002874.translation: Iulia Maxima, wife of Iulius Felicis and daughter of Iulius Leporinus, lived O F I S D years.
EDCS-13002874.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Iulia Maxima, recording her marital and paternal relationships and an incomplete lifespan.

EDCS-13002875.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Iulia Nina, daughter of Nigellio, dutiful, lived eighty years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002875.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Iulia Nina, dedicating her burial place to the Manes and recording her age at death.

EDCS-13002876.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Iulia Paullina, dutiful, lived forty years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002876.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Iulia Paullina, dedicating her burial place to the Manes and recording her age at death.

EDCS-13002877.translation: Iulia Saturnina, daughter of Iulius Severus, wife, lived fifty-five years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002877.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Iulia Saturnina, identifying her paternal lineage, marital status, and age at death.

EDCS-13002878.translation: Rogata, daughter of Ianuarius, lived thirty years. To the departed spirits. Saturnina, daughter of Secundus, lived twenty-five years. Iulia Victoria lived sixty years.
EDCS-13002878.summary: This inscription records the ages at death for at least three individuals: Rogata, Saturnina, and Iulia Victoria.

EDCS-13002880.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Iulia Nam. Quintus Iunius Gudeus, dutiful, lived ninety-two years, is buried here. Aquilinus, son of Tutor, lived sixty-six years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002880.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Quintus Iunius Gudeus and Aquilinus, both dedicated to the Manes, recording their ages and burials.

EDCS-13002881.translation: Peregrina, daughter of Silecis, wife of Iustus, lived forty years, is buried here. Sacred to the departed spirits. Iustulus, son of Barigbalis, dutiful, lived forty years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002881.summary: This inscription is a funerary epitaph for Peregrina and Iustulus, recording their ages and burials.

EDCS-13002882.translation: Libosa, daughter of Clemens, lived nineteen years, is buried in this place.
EDCS-13002882.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Libosa, recording her paternal lineage and age at death.

EDCS-13002883.translation: Marcus Licinius Bellicus, son of Romanus, dutiful, lived.
EDCS-13002883.summary: This is an incomplete funerary epitaph for Marcus Licinius Bellicus, recording his father's name and his own epithet.

EDCS-13002884.translation: Verria Mulsula, wife of Febinus. Lived. Lucius Licinius Febinus lived fifty-one years, is buried here.
EDCS-13002884.summary: This inscription records the burial of Lucius Licinius Febinus, who lived fifty-one years, and mentions Verria Mulsula as his wife.

EDCS-13002885.translation: To the departed spirits. M., freedwoman Sinerusa, lived 40 years. She is buried here.
EDCS-13002885.summary: A tombstone recording the death and burial of Sinerusa, a freedwoman.

EDCS-13002886.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. MAIIINLIVS II ORVM lived 105 years. He is buried here.
EDCS-13002886.summary: A tombstone recording the death and burial of MAIIINLIVS II ORVM, who lived 105 years.

EDCS-13002887.translation: To the departed spirits, sacred. Marchella lived 60 years. Ispesina lived 11 years. Baric Zabulli lived 20 years. He is buried here.
EDCS-13002887.summary: A tombstone recording the death and burial of Marchella, Ispesina, and Baric Zabulli.

EDCS-13002888.translation: IIEI Martialis, his wife A A DV MA, pious, lived.
EDCS-13002888.summary: An inscription that seems to record the death and piety of a woman named A A DV MA, wife of IIEI Martialis.

EDCS-13002889.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. M N, wife of MAR AVI, is buried here. Pus Martialis, son, lived 70 years. He is buried here.
EDCS-13002889.summary: A tombstone recording the burial of M N, wife of MAR AVI, and the death and burial of their son Pus Martialis.

EDCS-13002890.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Maxima, daughter of Bellicus, wife of Maximi, most rare and most obedient, lived 80 years. She is buried here. Maximus, son of Iulianus, grandson of Baricis, lived 85 years. He is buried here. Maximus, son of Maximi, grandson of Iulianus.
EDCS-13002890.summary: A tombstone recording the deaths and burials of Maxima and Maximus, noting their lineage and virtues.

EDCS-13002891.translation: Domitia Urbana lived 100 years. She is buried here. Memmius Mamo lived 37 years. He is buried here. Caius Memmius Felix lived 100 years. Quintus Memmius Primus lived 107 years. He is buried here.
EDCS-13002891.summary: A tombstone recording the deaths and burials of four individuals: Domitia Urbana, Memmius Mamo, Caius Memmius Felix, and Quintus Memmius Primus.

EDCS-13002893.translation: APRO, pious, lived 55 years. He is buried here. Mat tinus, pious. Maemia Maxima.
EDCS-13002893.summary: An epitaph recording the death and burial of APRO, and mentioning Mat tinus and Maemia Maxima.

EDCS-13002894.translation: Citin, son of Faustus. Natalis, son of Quintus.
EDCS-13002894.summary: An inscription that records the names and parentage of Citin and Natalis.

EDCS-13002895.translation: Nina, daughter of Baricis, lived 80 years.
EDCS-13002895.summary: An epitaph recording the death of Nina, daughter of Baricis, who lived 80 years.

EDCS-13002896.translation: Ianuaria, wife of Nundinarius, lived 80 years. Nundinarius lived 35 years.
EDCS-13002896.summary: This is a funerary inscription recording the lifespans of Ianuaria and her husband Nundinarius.

EDCS-13002897.translation: Numisius Datus lived 50 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13002897.summary: This is a funerary inscription recording the lifespan and burial of Numisius Datus.

EDCS-13002898.translation: Oppia Saturnina lived 25 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-13002898.summary: This is a funerary inscription recording the lifespan and burial of Oppia Saturnina.

EDCS-13002899.translation: Julius Honoratus, son of Africanus, lived 40 years.
EDCS-13002899.summary: This is a funerary inscription recording the lifespan of Julius Honoratus, son of Africanus.

EDCS-13002900.translation: Politus, son of Saturninus, lived 18 years.
EDCS-13002900.summary: This is a funerary inscription recording the lifespan of Politus, son of Saturninus.

EDCS-13002901.translation: Minucia Iuqunda lived [xx] years; she is buried here. Lucius Pulaenius Martialis lived 70 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13002901.summary: This is a paired funerary inscription recording the lifespans and burials of Minucia Iuqunda and Lucius Pulaenius Martialis.

EDCS-13002902.translation: Rogatus, son of Bellicus, lived 18 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13002902.summary: This is a funerary inscription recording the lifespan and burial of Rogatus, son of Bellicus.

EDCS-13002903.translation: Rogatus, son of Faustus, lived 60 years.
EDCS-13002903.summary: This is a funerary inscription recording the lifespan of Rogatus, son of Faustus.

EDCS-13002904.translation: Dedicated to the departed spirits. Rufinus Muracis, dutiful, lived 70 years; he is buried here. Maxima Felice, daughter, dutiful, lived 40 years; she is buried here. Masimus Rufini lived 15 years. Frontina, wife of Rufinus, lived 35 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-13002904.summary: This is a funerary inscription dedicated to the departed spirits, recording the lifespans and burials of Rufinus Muracis, his daughter Maxima Felice, Masimus Rufini, and Frontina, wife of Rufinus.

EDCS-13002905.translation: Dedicated to the departed spirits. Iulia Saturnina, dutiful, lived 75 years; she is buried here. Lucius Sallustius Marchellus, dutiful, lived 85 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13002905.summary: This is a funerary inscription dedicated to the departed spirits, recording the lifespans and burials of Iulia Saturnina and Lucius Sallustius Marchellus.

EDCS-13002906.translation: Berec, son of Saturninus, lived 75 years, he is buried here. Saturninus, son of Victor, lived 90 years, he is buried here.
EDCS-13002906.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the ages and burial of two individuals, Berec and Saturninus.

EDCS-13002907.translation: Saturninus, son of Barichis, lived 45 years, he is buried here.
EDCS-13002907.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the age and burial of Saturninus, son of Barichis.

EDCS-13002908.translation: Birict, son of Fronto, pious, lived 75 years, he is buried here. Saturninus, son of Clemens, lived 105 years, he is buried here.
EDCS-13002908.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the ages and burial of two individuals, Birict and Saturninus.

EDCS-13002909.translation: Saturus, son of Saturi Buldes, lived 70 years, he is buried here. Saturnia, daughter of Saturi, lived [an unspecified number of] years.
EDCS-13002909.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the age and burial of Saturus and the incomplete lifespan of Saturnia.

EDCS-13002910.translation: [...] lived Seius A IVN VI L [---]
EDCS-13002910.summary: This is a fragmentary funerary epitaph recording the name and lifespan of Seius, with significant portions missing.

EDCS-13003043.summary: A funerary epitaph recording the death of Caius Flavius Fortunatus, who lived 33 years.

EDCS-13003045.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Marcus Furius Manrusius, dutiful, lived 36 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13003045.summary: A funerary epitaph recording the death of Marcus Furius Manrusius, who lived 36 years.

EDCS-13003046.translation: Anobal Gaetullus, honored, dutiful, lived 56 years; he is buried here. Sacred to the departed spirits. Quintus Soberinus lived 70 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13003046.summary: A funerary epitaph recording the deaths of Anobal Gaetullus (age 56) and Quintus Soberinus (age 70).

EDCS-13003047.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Sallustia Mustacia placed [this] while alive. Sacred to the departed spirits. Sallustia Mustacia placed [this] for her dearest husband Quintus Gellius Auxiticus, dutiful, who lived 52 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13003047.summary: A funerary epitaph placed by Sallustia Mustacia for her husband Quintus Gellius Auxiticus, who lived 52 years.

EDCS-13003048.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Herennia Flaminica, dutiful, lived 22 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-13003048.summary: A funerary epitaph recording the death of Herennia Flaminica, who lived 22 years.

EDCS-13003049.translation: Lucius Iulius Matutinus, son of Tiberius, of the Fabia tribe, dutiful, lived 40 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13003049.summary: A funerary epitaph recording the death of Lucius Iulius Matutinus, who lived 40 years.

EDCS-13003050.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Iulia Ianuaria, daughter of Tiberius, lived 21 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-13003050.summary: A funerary epitaph for Iulia Ianuaria, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13003051.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Iulia Mustacia, also called Matthaca, dutiful, lived 12 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-13003051.summary: A funerary epitaph for Iulia Mustacia (Matthaca), dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13003052.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Lucius Muttius Fortunatus Gellupus, dutiful, lived 55 years; he is buried here. Sacred to the departed spirits. Iunia Matrona, dutiful, lived 38 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-13003052.summary: A double funerary epitaph for Lucius Muttius Fortunatus Gellupus and Iunia Matrona, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13003053.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Manilius Urbanus, dutiful, lived 70 years.
EDCS-13003053.summary: A funerary epitaph for Manilius Urbanus, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13003054.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Ianuaria, wife of Martialis, dutiful, lived 41 years; she is buried here. Sacred to the departed spirits. Martialis, son of Fronto, made this for himself while alive, dutiful, lived 75 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13003054.summary: A double funerary epitaph for Ianuaria and her husband Martialis, with the latter dedicating the monument during his lifetime, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13003055.translation: Martialis, son of Herennius, lived 45 years, dutiful son, is here.
EDCS-13003055.summary: A funerary epitaph for Martialis, son of Herennius, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13003056.translation: Quinta, daughter of Quintus Arinis, wife of Iuvenalis Vartimus, dutiful, lived 81 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-13003056.summary: A funerary epitaph for Quinta, wife of Iuvenalis Vartimus, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13003057.summary: A funerary epitaph for Secundus, son of Eros, dating to the Roman Imperial period, though incomplete.

EDCS-13003058.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Sextilia Helpis, wife of Buturarius, dutiful, lived [missing age]. Sacred to the departed spirits. Marcus Sextilius Buturarius, son of Iulius Rufinus, made this for himself while alive, dutiful, lived [missing age].
EDCS-13003058.summary: A double funerary epitaph for Sextilia Helpis and her husband Marcus Sextilius Buturarius, with the latter dedicating the monument during his lifetime, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13003059.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Spes, daughter of Communis, dutiful, lived 15 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-13003059.summary: A funerary epitaph for Spes, daughter of Communis, dating to the Roman Imperial period.

EDCS-13003060.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Sulpicius Flaminius Severus, son of Flaminius, built this tomb in memory of his life, which was spent in devotion to the monitor of all; he lived a devout man for 93 years and is buried here.
EDCS-13003060.summary: This funerary monument was erected by Sulpicius Flaminius Severus for himself, commemorating his life and burial.

EDCS-13003061.translation: Marcus Ulpius Dativus, while alive, set this up for himself and his family, sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Anicia Matrona, devout, lived for 55 years and is buried here, [along with] Marcus Anicius Vitalis, Aniciae Dativa and Ianuaria.
EDCS-13003061.summary: This tomb was established by Marcus Ulpius Dativus for himself and his family, and records the burial of Anicia Matrona and others.

EDCS-13003062.translation: Quintus Volussius Epicrates erected this for himself while alive; he lived a devout man for 90 years and is buried here.
EDCS-13003062.summary: This funerary monument was erected by Quintus Volussius Epicrates for himself, commemorating his life and burial.

EDCS-13003063.translation: Zabo, son of Ieptanis, lived for 90 years and is buried here.
EDCS-13003063.summary: This inscription records the burial of Zabo, son of Ieptanis, who lived for 90 years.

EDCS-13003064.translation: Zabulla, daughter of Saturninis, wife of Florus, a devout woman, lived for 25 years and is buried here.
EDCS-13003064.summary: This inscription records the burial of Zabulla, daughter of Saturninis and wife of Florus, who died at the age of 25.

EDCS-13003067.translation: Quintus Alidus Ianuarius, devout, lived for 101 years.
EDCS-13003067.summary: This inscription commemorates Quintus Alidus Ianuarius, who lived for 101 years.

EDCS-13003087.translation: Sacred to Hercules Augustus. [Dedication] by Optatus, [son of] Marci Caeserni Severi Sulpiciani.
EDCS-13003087.summary: This is a dedication to Hercules Augustus made by Optatus.

EDCS-13003088.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. [He/She] lived for 21 years.
EDCS-13003088.summary: This funerary inscription records the lifespan of an individual who lived for 21 years.

EDCS-13003089.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Cassia Novella lived for 111 years.
EDCS-13003089.summary: This funerary inscription records the lifespan of Cassia Novella, who lived for 111 years.

EDCS-13003090.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Crispinus, devout, lived for 75 years and is buried here.
EDCS-13003090.summary: This funerary monument records that Crispinus, a devout man, lived for 75 years and is buried here.

EDCS-13003091.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the lifespan of Cutiul.

EDCS-13003092.translation: Sacred to the Divine Spirits. The pious Flamen lived 81 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13003092.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for a priest (Flamen) who lived 81 years, dedicated to the Divine Spirits.

EDCS-13003093.translation: Sacred to the Divine Spirits. The pious Iustus lived 25 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13003093.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Iustus who lived 25 years, dedicated to the Divine Spirits.

EDCS-13003095.translation: Maia lived 16 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-13003095.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Maia who lived 16 years.

EDCS-13003096.translation: Sacred to the Divine Spirits. Masik lived 110 years.
EDCS-13003096.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Masik who lived 110 years, dedicated to the Divine Spirits.

EDCS-13003097.translation: To Montu, son of Iusius, from Gaia.
EDCS-13003097.summary: This is a dedication, likely votive, from Gaia to Montu, son of Iusius.

EDCS-13003098.translation: Sacred to the Divine Spirits. Nina, daughter of Arso, lived 80 years.
EDCS-13003098.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Nina, daughter of Arso, who lived 80 years, dedicated to the Divine Spirits.

EDCS-13003100.translation: Sacred to the Divine Spirits. Saro the pious lived 27 years. May you rest well here.
EDCS-13003100.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Saro who lived 27 years, with a wish for peaceful rest, dedicated to the Divine Spirits.

EDCS-13003101.translation: Sacred to the Divine Spirits. Satura lived 100 years.
EDCS-13003101.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Satura who lived 100 years, dedicated to the Divine Spirits.

EDCS-13003102.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for the pious Spesina who lived 30 years.

EDCS-13003103.translation: Thisran, son of Saltumis, the dutiful, lived for 60 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13003103.summary: A funerary epitaph for Thisran, son of Saltumis, who lived to be 60.

EDCS-13003104.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Dead. Vasar lived for 21 years.
EDCS-13003104.summary: A funerary epitaph for Vasar, who died at the age of 21.

EDCS-13003105.translation: Vatimat, daughter of Baliatonis, lived for 16 years.
EDCS-13003105.summary: A funerary epitaph for Vatimat, daughter of Baliatonis, who died at the age of 16.

EDCS-13003106.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Dead. Viderud lived for 85 years.
EDCS-13003106.summary: A funerary epitaph for Viderud, who died at the age of 85.

EDCS-13003110.translation: To the Six August Emperors, Lucius Septimius Severus Pius Pertinax Arabicus Adiabenicus Maximus, Fortissimus, Felicissimus, Father of the Fatherland, and Marcus Aurelius Antoninus Pius Felix, and of their entire divine house, Titus Flavius Faustus, son of Masofis, as magistrate, made a statue from his own pledge in his year, with an additional 1200 sesterces added by himself, and dedicated it, with Baricio, son of Cinnea, overseeing the work.
EDCS-13003110.summary: A dedication of a statue by Titus Flavius Faustus, a magistrate, to six emperors including Septimius Severus and Caracalla, likely dating to the early 3rd century CE.

EDCS-13003111.translation: The Emperor Caesar, son of the Emperor Caesar Lucius Septimius Severus Pertinax Augustus Pius Arabicus Adiabenicus Parthicus, Pontifex, grandson of the deified Marcus Aurelius Antoninus Pius Germanicus Sarmaticus, great-grandson of the deified Antoninus Pius, great-great-grandson of the deified Hadrian, great-great-great-grandson of the deified Trajan Parthicus, great-great-great-great-grandson of the deified Nerva, the Emperor Caesar Marcus Aurelius Antoninus Augustus, the state, by decree and the contribution of the decurions, made and dedicated this from 2400 sesterces.
EDCS-13003111.summary: A public works dedication by the state, likely initiated by Caracalla, mentioning his imperial lineage and funded by the town council, likely dating to his co-rule with Septimius Severus or shortly after.

EDCS-13003112.translation: Lucius Aemilius Aries lived for 45 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13003112.summary: A funerary epitaph for Lucius Aemilius Aries, who died at the age of 45.

EDCS-13003113.translation: Sacred to the spirits. Lucius Pontius Extricatus made this for himself and his own, [though he lived] to a mature age, life brief, [in] II (or III) days [he rests] now secure, my name certainly surviving will always remain here for you in this inscription.
EDCS-13003113.summary: A funerary epitaph for Lucius Pontius Extricatus, who made it for himself and his family, lamenting a brief life.

EDCS-13003114.translation: Septima, daughter of Maximu s, made this for herself while alive; she lived for 60 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-13003114.summary: A funerary epitaph for Septima, daughter of Maximu s, who made it for herself during her lifetime and died at the age of 60.

EDCS-13003116.translation: ira Pa IARC III lived for 41 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-13003116.summary: A funerary epitaph for ira Pa IARC III, who died at the age of 41.

EDCS-13003118.translation: To the spirits of the departed. Quintus Caecilius Fasio lived 65 years. Cornelia Secunda lived 75 years. Cornelios Zaboni lived 10 years.
EDCS-13003118.summary: A funerary inscription recording the ages at death of three individuals: Quintus Caecilius Fasio, Cornelia Secunda, and Cornelios Zaboni.

EDCS-13003119.translation: Gemellus, son of Balienis, lived [X] years. Saturnina, daughter of Gemellus, lived 20 years. Boroc Martialis, daughter, lived [X] years. Gemellus, son, lived [X] years.
EDCS-13003119.summary: A funerary inscription listing the ages at death of Gemellus, Saturnina, Boroc Martialis, and another Gemellus, likely family members.

EDCS-13003120.translation: Iulius Fortunatus made this sacred offering at his own expense. Iulia Myronice lived 80 years. Iulius Fortunatus lived 80 years. Antonia, daughter, made this; she is buried here.
EDCS-13003120.summary: A funerary inscription where Iulius Fortunatus dedicated a tomb for himself and Iulia Myronice, and his daughter Antonia also dedicated it for him after his death.

EDCS-13003121.summary: A very short inscription, possibly an abbreviation or fragment, that invokes the clemency of rulers, likely from the imperial period.

EDCS-13003122.translation: To the spirits of the departed. Marcus Valerius Celsus, dutiful, lived 64 years; he is buried here. To the spirits of the departed, a sacred offering. Claudia Silvana, his wife, lived [X] years. To the spirits of the departed, a sacred offering. Marcus Valerius Prodigus, dutiful, lived 26 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13003122.summary: A funerary inscription recording the ages at death and burial of Marcus Valerius Celsus, his wife Claudia Silvana, and Marcus Valerius Prodigus, likely a son.

EDCS-13003123.translation: To the spirits of the departed, a sacred offering. Domitius Terminus, dutiful, lived [X] years.
EDCS-13003123.summary: A funerary inscription recording the death of Domitius Terminus, described as 'piae' (dutiful/pious), with a lacuna for her age and potentially other details.

EDCS-13003125.translation: To the spirits of the departed, a sacred offering. Biligbal, dutiful, lived 55 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-13003125.summary: A funerary inscription for Biligbal, who lived 55 years and is buried at this location.

EDCS-13003126.translation: To the spirits of the departed, a sacred offering. Veneria Ster[---] lived [X] years.
EDCS-13003126.summary: A funerary inscription for Veneria Ster[---], with missing information about her age and full name.

EDCS-13003128.translation: [ILIAMAC], wife of G, lived 95 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-13003128.summary: A funerary inscription for the wife of 'G', who lived 95 years and is buried at this location.

EDCS-13003130.translation: To the spirits of the departed. Licinius Musteolus lived 81 years.
EDCS-13003130.summary: A funerary inscription recording the death of Licinius Musteolus at the age of 81.

EDCS-13003131.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Underworld. Julius Inpetratus lived 71 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13003131.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Julius Inpetratus, recording his name, lifespan, and burial.

EDCS-13003132.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Underworld. Magdal, dutiful freedwoman, lived 23 years. May the earth lie lightly on your bones.
EDCS-13003132.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Magdal, recording her name, lifespan, and a wish for peace in the afterlife.

EDCS-13003133.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Underworld. Berecbal the dutiful lived 40 years. Sacred to the Spirits of the Underworld. Marisciani lived 35 years.
EDCS-13003133.summary: This inscription contains two separate funerary epitaphs, one for Berecbal and one for Marisciani, recording their lifespans.

EDCS-13003134.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Underworld. Rogata the dutiful lived 85 years; may you rest well here. Sacred to the Spirits of the Underworld. Marius Orfitus the dutiful lived 85 years; may you rest well here.
EDCS-13003134.summary: This inscription contains two separate funerary epitaphs, one for Rogata and one for Marius Orfitus, recording their lifespans and wishes for rest.

EDCS-13003135.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Underworld. Matrona, daughter of Donatus, lived 15 years. May the earth lie lightly on your bones; may the earth be yours.
EDCS-13003135.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Matrona, daughter of Donatus, recording her name, lifespan, and a wish for peace in the afterlife.

EDCS-13003136.translation: Mitthunbal the dutiful lived 65 years. May the earth lie lightly on your bones.
EDCS-13003136.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Mitthunbal, recording his name, lifespan, and a wish for peace in the afterlife.

EDCS-13003137.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Underworld. Sanam, wife of Primus, lived 41 years.
EDCS-13003137.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Sanam, wife of Primus, recording her name and lifespan.

EDCS-13003138.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Underworld. Namphame, wife of Quadratus, lived 86 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-13003138.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Namphame, wife of Quadratus, recording her name, lifespan, and burial.

EDCS-13003139.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Underworld. Silec Telilis the dutiful lived 95 years.
EDCS-13003139.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Silec Telilis, recording his name, epithet, and lifespan.

EDCS-13003140.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Underworld. Claudia Pusinna the dutiful lived 16 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-13003140.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Claudia Pusinna, recording her name, epithet, lifespan, and burial.

EDCS-13003141.translation: Caius Agileius Gemelus lived for 71 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13003141.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the lifespan and burial of Caius Agileius Gemelus.

EDCS-13003142.translation: Dedicated to the departed spirits. Publius Gargilius Felix lived for 75 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13003142.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the lifespan and burial of Publius Gargilius Felix.

EDCS-13003143.translation: Dedicated to the departed spirits. Baricbal Dati lived for [...] years.
EDCS-13003143.summary: This is a funerary epitaph, likely incomplete, recording the lifespan of Baricbal Dati.

EDCS-13003145.translation: Dedicated to the departed spirits. Iulius Securus, dutiful, lived for 105 years.
EDCS-13003145.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the lifespan of Iulius Securus.

EDCS-13003146.translation: Dedicated to the departed spirits. Butur lived for 75 years. Dedicated to the departed spirits. N. R. B. C.
EDCS-13003146.summary: This funerary epitaph records the lifespan of Butur and includes an incomplete or abbreviated dedication.

EDCS-13003147.translation: Flavia Maura lived for 85 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-13003147.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the lifespan and burial of Flavia Maura.

EDCS-13003148.translation: Dedicated to the departed spirits. Kastula.
EDCS-13003148.summary: This is a funerary epitaph that simply records the name Kastula, dedicated to the departed spirits.

EDCS-13003149.translation: Dedicated to Mars Augustus. Caius Pompeius Victor, as magister, by order of the owner of the land, Saturninus, made and dedicated the altar with his own money.
EDCS-13003149.summary: This is a dedication to Mars Augustus by Caius Pompeius Victor, who acted as magister and funded the altar's construction.

EDCS-13003151.translation: Dedicated to the departed spirits. Quintus Flavius Felix Faustinianus, dutiful, lived for 65 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13003151.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the lifespan and burial of Quintus Flavius Felix Faustinianus.

EDCS-13003152.translation: [...]tius lived for 76 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13003152.summary: This is an incomplete funerary epitaph recording the lifespan and burial of a person whose name begins with 'tius'.

EDCS-13003153.translation: Sacred to the Divine Manes. Farius Tertullinus lived 40 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13003153.summary: A funerary epitaph recording the death of Farius Tertullinus, who lived 40 years.

EDCS-13003154.translation: Sacred to the Divine Manes. Paternus, son of Zaedon, lived 37 years.
EDCS-13003154.summary: A funerary epitaph recording the death of Paternus, son of Zaedon, who lived 37 years.

EDCS-13003155.translation: Tuninus, son of Zaedon, pious, lived 25 years.
EDCS-13003155.summary: A funerary epitaph recording the death of Tuninus, son of Zaedon, who lived 25 years.

EDCS-13003156.translation: Sacred to the Divine Manes. Staberia Candida, pious, lived...
EDCS-13003156.summary: An incomplete funerary epitaph for Staberia Candida.

EDCS-13003158.summary: A funerary epitaph recording the death of Rastus, identified as a Numidian, who lived 20 years.

EDCS-13003160.translation: Publius Caninius Romanus, son of Quintus, of the Arnensian tribe, pious, lived 80 years. A Roman.
EDCS-13003160.summary: A funerary epitaph for Publius Caninius Romanus, detailing his age and tribal affiliation.

EDCS-13003161.translation: Salvius Fuscus, son of Lucius, of the Quirina tribe, formerly prefect of the engineers, twice aedile, twice quinquennial duovir, placed this silver statue, worth 50,000 sesterces, with 335,000 additional sesterces, after promising 10,000 sesterces to the state and an additional 7,000 sesterces for the silver statues of Emperor Caesar Trajan Hadrian Augustus, in his own name and that of his son Caius Salvius Restitutus; he also dedicated it with a golden crown.
EDCS-13003161.summary: An inscription by Salvius Fuscus detailing his generous public benefactions, including the funding of a silver statue of Emperor Hadrian, and his public offices, likely dating to the Hadrianic period.

EDCS-13003164.summary: A brief inscription honoring Aurelius, described as 'most distinguished'.

EDCS-13003165.translation: Sacred to the Divine Manes. Claudius Severus, veteran, lived 61 years and 12 days; he served 25 years. To Claudius Restutus, his most pious father.
EDCS-13003165.summary: A funerary epitaph for Claudius Severus, a veteran, and a dedication to his father Claudius Restutus.

EDCS-13003166.translation: Sacred to the Divine Manes. Maxentius, senator from the select guard, faithful, lived 70 years in peace; he rested on the day of the Nones of August, in the 15th indiction.
EDCS-13003166.summary: A funerary epitaph for Maxentius, a senator and member of the elite guard, indicating his peaceful life and date of death.

EDCS-13003170.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. Lucius Apuleius Barbarus lived 31 years, 1 month, and 8 days; he is buried here.
EDCS-13003170.summary: A funerary inscription recording the lifespan and burial of Lucius Apuleius Barbarus.

EDCS-13003171.translation: To the spirits of the underworld. Marcus Astius Restuttus lived 10 years.
EDCS-13003171.summary: A funerary inscription recording the lifespan of Marcus Astius Restuttus.

EDCS-13003172.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. Lucius Flavius Pudentianus lived 5 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13003172.summary: A funerary inscription recording the lifespan and burial of Lucius Flavius Pudentianus.

EDCS-13003173.summary: A fragmentary inscription possibly naming Fufia Victorina.

EDCS-13003175.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. Iulia Eucarpia lived.
EDCS-13003175.summary: A funerary inscription recording the lifespan of Iulia Eucarpia, though the duration is missing.

EDCS-13003176.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. Livia Ninosa lived 25 years and 3 months; she is buried here.
EDCS-13003176.summary: A funerary inscription recording the lifespan and burial of Livia Ninosa.

EDCS-13003177.summary: A fragmentary inscription possibly naming Pompeia Veneria.

EDCS-13003179.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. For Vivatia Asclepia, dearest younger daughter, who lived 6 years and 16 days.
EDCS-13003179.summary: A funerary inscription for Vivatia Asclepia, detailing her age at death and relationship.

EDCS-13003181.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. Clodius Ianuarius lived 28 years and [missing duration].
EDCS-13003181.summary: A funerary inscription recording the lifespan of Clodius Ianuarius, though the full duration is missing.

EDCS-13003182.summary: A fragmentary inscription recording the lifespan of an unnamed individual.

EDCS-13003183.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Dope V E lived 71 years. Her sons made this.
EDCS-13003183.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Dope V E, who lived 71 years, set up by her sons.

EDCS-13003186.translation: Custos, subdeacon, lived 19 years, 5 months in peace, and rested on the sixth day before the Kalends of April.
EDCS-13003186.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Custos, a subdeacon, who died on March 27th after living 19 years and 5 months.

EDCS-13003187.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Albania Cattosa lived 17 years.
EDCS-13003187.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Albania Cattosa, who lived 17 years.

EDCS-13003189.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Flavius Matzon IIS lived 60 years, 5 months, and 10 days.
EDCS-13003189.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Flavius Matzon IIS, who lived 60 years, 5 months, and 10 days.

EDCS-13003191.translation: Alecinus lived 36 years. He is buried here.
EDCS-13003191.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Alecinus, who lived 36 years and is buried here.

EDCS-13003192.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Quintus Iulius E E Saturninus Secundus, aedile, twice chief magistrate of the municipality of N [---] VG, lived 10 years [---].
EDCS-13003192.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Quintus Iulius E E Saturninus Secundus, an official, who lived approximately 10 years.

EDCS-13003193.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Munatia Castula, perpetual priestess of the municipality of Thubursicensis, daughter of Munatius Festus, dutiful, lived 41 years. She is buried here.
EDCS-13003193.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Munatia Castula, daughter of Munatius Festus and a perpetual priestess, who lived 41 years.

EDCS-13003194.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Lucius Iulius Munatianus Cestianus, dutiful, priest of Saturn, lived 2 years, 10 months, and 28 days. He is buried here.
EDCS-13003194.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Lucius Iulius Munatianus Cestianus, a priest of Saturn, who lived 2 years, 10 months, and 28 days.

EDCS-13003196.translation: Claudia Fortunata, mother of 12 children, lived 50 years. Caius Salvienus, father of children, lived 80 years.
EDCS-13003196.summary: This is a funerary inscription commemorating Claudia Fortunata, who had 12 children and lived 50 years, and Caius Salvienus, who lived 80 years.

EDCS-13003205.translation: To the genius of the state of Siso Sa Hibiar, Ianuarius Vindicis son and Hamannu dedicated [this].
EDCS-13003205.summary: This inscription records the dedication to the genius of the state of Siso Sa Hibiar by Ianuarius Vindicis son and Hamannu.

EDCS-13003206.translation: Sacred to Pluto the Lord; the magistrates had it made at public expense by Aisuri, son of Felix Nivamone.
EDCS-13003206.summary: This is a dedication to Pluto funded by public money and overseen by local magistrates.

EDCS-13003210.translation: To Victorious Felix Augustus, the colony.
EDCS-13003210.summary: This inscription is likely a dedication or acclamation to the emperor Felix Augustus by a colony.

EDCS-13003212.translation: He who was most distinguished, the legate, placed this.
EDCS-13003212.summary: This monument was erected by a high-ranking official, identified as a legate of consular rank (vir clarissimus).

EDCS-13003222.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. Quintus Iulius Felix, a pious Roman knight, lived for 25 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-13003222.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Quintus Iulius Felix, a Roman knight, recording his age at death.

EDCS-13003224.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. Callista, the pious one, lived for 40 years. Eutyches made this for his well-deserving wife.
EDCS-13003224.summary: This is a funerary epitaph set up by Eutyches for his wife Callista, stating her age at death.

EDCS-13003227.summary: This is an incomplete funerary inscription for Gaius Fabius Germanus, likely recording his age at death.

EDCS-13003228.translation: This hero, pious, lived for 80 years; he is buried here. Prima, the pious one, lived for 90 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-13003228.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the ages at death of a male hero and Prima, indicating they were buried at this location.

EDCS-13003230.summary: This is a funerary inscription recording the lifespan of an individual named Viais Incinus.

EDCS-13003231.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. Valeria Faustina lived for 50 years. Iulius Baricio, the pious one, lived for 52 years.
EDCS-13003231.summary: This is a joint funerary inscription for Valeria Faustina and Iulius Baricio, recording their ages at death.

EDCS-13003232.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. Iulius Cicero lived for 65 years. Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. Honorata Primosa lived for 21 years.
EDCS-13003232.summary: This inscription contains two separate funerary notices, one for Iulius Cicero and another for Honorata Primosa, stating their ages at death.

EDCS-13003233.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Dead. Iulia Rustica lived 10 years. Caius Iulius Maxentius lived 17 years.
EDCS-13003233.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Iulia Rustica and Caius Iulius Maxentius, recording their ages at death.

EDCS-13003234.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Dead. Iulius Maximus lived [---]. Sacred to the Spirits of the Dead. Annia Prima lived 35 years.
EDCS-13003234.summary: This inscription appears to be a composite epitaph for Iulius Maximus and Annia Prima, with Annia Prima's age at death provided.

EDCS-13003235.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Dead. Iulia Prima.
EDCS-13003235.summary: This is a simple funerary epitaph for Iulia Prima, dedicated to the Spirits of the Dead.

EDCS-13003236.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Dead. Valeria Restuta lived [---]. Iulius Saturninus lived 70 years.
EDCS-13003236.summary: This funerary epitaph records the age at death of Iulius Saturninus and mentions Valeria Restuta, likely another individual commemorated here.

EDCS-13003237.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Dead. Iulius Saturus Vodias lived 90 years. S H M.
EDCS-13003237.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Iulius Saturus Vodias, recording his age at death and an abbreviated formula.
