EDCS-24501849.translation: is usio tor fulfilled his vow.
EDCS-24501849.summary: This is a dedication inscription where someone fulfilled a vow, likely from the Roman imperial period.

EDCS-24501850.translation: of Septimius Severus Pertinax, the Adidas, the Arab, the Parthian, most brave, chief priest.
EDCS-24501850.summary: This inscription names Emperor Septimius Severus Pertinax, mentioning his titles and military successes, likely from his reign (193-211 AD).

EDCS-24501851.translation: For the health of the Emperor Caesar mus, with tribunician power.
EDCS-24501851.summary: This is a dedication for the health of an emperor, mentioning his tribunician power, likely from the Roman imperial period.

EDCS-24501854.translation: consul, father of the fatherland Inv
EDCS-24501854.summary: This is a fragmentary inscription mentioning a consul and 'father of the fatherland', likely from the Roman imperial period.

EDCS-24501855.summary: This is a fragmentary inscription likely referring to a dedication or honor bestowed upon Gaius Fabius by the state, probably from the Roman imperial period.

EDCS-24501857.translation: us Aurelius Paulinus, foremost in the city, flourishing with descendants, sixty-seven years and thirty days.
EDCS-24501857.summary: This is a funerary inscription for us Aurelius Paulinus, noting his prominence and age, likely from the Roman imperial period.

EDCS-24501858.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Lucius Caecilius Cududus lived 70 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-24501858.summary: A funerary epitaph recording the death of Lucius Caecilius Cududus, who lived to be 70 years old.

EDCS-24501859.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Clodia Secunda lived 65 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-24501859.summary: A funerary epitaph recording the death of Clodia Secunda, who lived to be 65 years old.

EDCS-24501860.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Augustu(s) Vilius Pius lived 75 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-24501860.summary: A funerary epitaph recording the death of Augustu(s) Vilius Pius, who lived to be 75 years old.

EDCS-24501861.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Flavia Terulla lived 18 years; she is buried here. Sacred to the departed spirits. Flavius Fortunatus lived 2 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-24501861.summary: A funerary epitaph recording the deaths of two individuals, Flavia Terulla (18 years old) and Flavius Fortunatus (2 years old).

EDCS-24501862.translation: Ilia, daughter of Cn(aeus), Marcella, dutiful, lived 90 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-24501862.summary: A funerary epitaph for Ilia Marcella, daughter of Cn(aeus), who lived to be 90 years old.

EDCS-24501863.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits and to the memory of Polia Secunda, dutiful, chaste, beloved by her student husband and her own family. She lived 17 years. Aechana Marcellus, her husband, to his dearest wife, buried here.
EDCS-24501863.summary: A funerary epitaph by Aechana Marcellus to his wife Polia Secunda, who died at 17 years old.

EDCS-24501864.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Sextus Pompeius Maximus lived 62 years, 5 months, and 3 days; he is buried here.
EDCS-24501864.summary: A funerary epitaph recording the death of Sextus Pompeius Maximus, who lived to be 62 years, 5 months, and 3 days old.

EDCS-24501866.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Publius Roiius Afri lived twenty years; he is buried here.
EDCS-24501866.summary: A funerary epitaph recording the death of Publius Roiius Afri, who lived to be 20 years old.

EDCS-24501867.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Caius V(alentinus?) Fortunatus lived 61 years. Iulia Secundina lived 60 years.
EDCS-24501867.summary: A funerary epitaph recording the ages at death of Caius V(alentinus?) Fortunatus (61 years) and Iulia Secundina (60 years).

EDCS-24501869.translation: S(extus?) Lucius Antistius lived 2 months and 5 days. Iulia Vita lived 15 months and 3 days. Lucius Antis(tius?) lived 50 years. [---] lived 73 years. [---] lived 12 years. Lucius Antistius lived 4 years. Lucius Antistius Florentinus lived 72 years and 5 months and 17 days. Sacred to the departed spirits. Antistia Pia lived 70 years. Antistia Victoria lived [---]. Lucius Antistius Rusticianus lived 53 years. Lucius Antistius Antistiolus lived 1 year.
EDCS-24501869.summary: A complex funerary inscription likely for multiple members of the Antistii family, detailing various ages at death, including infants and adults.

EDCS-24501870.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Arruntius Felix lived 30 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-24501870.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the age at death of Arruntius Felix.

EDCS-24501871.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Caius Arruntius Gallicianus lived 71 years.
EDCS-24501871.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the age at death of Caius Arruntius Gallicianus.

EDCS-24501872.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Peticia Prima lived 55 years; she is buried here. Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Arruntius Gemelus lived 83 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-24501872.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the ages at death of two individuals, Peticia Prima and Arruntius Gemelus.

EDCS-24501873.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Publius Arruntius Gemellus lived 110 years.
EDCS-24501873.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the age at death of Publius Arruntius Gemellus.

EDCS-24501874.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Arruntius Ianuarius lived 80 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-24501874.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the age at death of Arruntius Ianuarius.

EDCS-24501875.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Arruntius Ianuarius Iunior lived 25 years.
EDCS-24501875.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the age at death of Arruntius Ianuarius Iunior.

EDCS-24501876.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Caius Arruntius Lucius lived 33 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-24501876.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the age at death of Caius Arruntius Lucius.

EDCS-24501877.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Arruntius Rufianus lived 16 years.
EDCS-24501877.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the age at death of Arruntius Rufianus.

EDCS-24501878.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Caius Arruntius Rusticianus lived 61 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-24501878.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the age at death of Caius Arruntius Rusticianus.

EDCS-24501879.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Caius Arruntius Saturninus lived 70 years.
EDCS-24501879.summary: This is a funerary epitaph recording the age at death of Caius Arruntius Saturninus.

EDCS-24501880.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Quintus Fabius Donatus lived 23 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-24501880.summary: This is a tombstone inscription recording the death of Quintus Fabius Donatus, who lived for 23 years.

EDCS-24501881.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Rogatia lived 10 years and 5 months.
EDCS-24501881.summary: This is a tombstone inscription recording the death of Rogatia, who died at the age of 10 years and 5 months.

EDCS-24501882.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Seia Victoria lived 71 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-24501882.summary: This is a tombstone inscription recording the death of Seia Victoria, who lived for 71 years.

EDCS-24501883.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Ama lived 73 years.
EDCS-24501883.summary: This is a tombstone inscription recording the death of Ama, who lived for 73 years.

EDCS-24501884.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Caecilia Miriana lived 20 years.
EDCS-24501884.summary: This is a tombstone inscription recording the death of Caecilia Miriana, who lived for 20 years.

EDCS-24501885.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Salvius Pius lived 29 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-24501885.summary: This is a tombstone inscription recording the death of Salvius Pius, who lived for 29 years.

EDCS-24501886.translation: To L. L. L. Andus for his wife Ocfiicis Nrsorpi, his very dear husband.
EDCS-24501886.summary: This is a funerary inscription dedicated by a husband to his wife, L. L. L. Andus to Ocfiicis Nrsorpi.

EDCS-24501887.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Flavia Silva Dona lived 25 years.
EDCS-24501887.summary: This is a tombstone inscription recording the death of Flavia Silva Dona, who lived for 25 years.

EDCS-24501888.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Quintus Iulius Arabus.
EDCS-24501888.summary: This is a tombstone inscription recording the death of Quintus Iulius Arabus.

EDCS-24501889.translation: Afranius Fortunatianus to his wife Secundilla, an honored and most rare woman.
EDCS-24501889.summary: This is a funerary inscription dedicated by a husband, Afranius Fortunatianus, to his highly esteemed wife, Secundilla.

EDCS-24501891.translation: To Aelia Valeria Kapitolina Pompeiana, wife of Caius Ofillius Rufus, for the entire curia of the municipality of Cillitani, on account of the exceptional love of her husband for them.
EDCS-24501891.summary: This inscription honors Aelia Valeria Kapitolina Pompeiana, wife of Caius Ofillius Rufus, likely a funerary monument or a dedication by the local council.

EDCS-24501892.translation: The council, by decree of the decurions, erected this to Marcus Alumnus Iaiae, an incomparable citizen, at their own expense, and granted this place.
EDCS-24501892.summary: This inscription records a public monument erected by the town council to honor Marcus Alumnus Iaiae.

EDCS-24501893.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Aelius Iucundus, also called Viranus, lived 85 years. His wife Aelia Urbana lived 65 years. Therefore, eternal home will be here for us, rest from labor, here will be death.
EDCS-24501893.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Aelius Iucundus and his wife Aelia Urbana, expressing a desire for eternal rest.

EDCS-24501894.translation: Aelia Hedone, pious daughter of Publius, lived 51 years, 4 months, 12 days. Publius Aelius Libanus, pious son of Publius, lived 50 years, 10 months, 6 days. He is buried here.
EDCS-24501894.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Aelia Hedone and Publius Aelius Libanus, providing their ages at death.

EDCS-24501895.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Caelia Metitia, pious, lived 70 years. She is buried here. Her daughters Maxima Secunda, Opta, and Matropiaea took care of the arrangements.
EDCS-24501895.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Caelia Metitia, buried by her daughters.

EDCS-24501897.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Nasidia Secunda, pious, lived 62 years. She is buried here.
EDCS-24501897.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Nasidia Secunda, providing her age at death.

EDCS-24501898.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Primaiahina Victoria, most obedient, lived 2000 years.
EDCS-24501898.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Primaiahina Victoria, likely using hyperbole for her age.

EDCS-24501899.translation: Sadurus, son of Sodalis, pious, is buried here. He lived 13 years.
EDCS-24501899.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Sadurus, son of Sodalis, providing his age at death.

EDCS-24501900.translation: To IAIIPII Napia, who lived 9 years and 11 months. Her father Honori erected this against the vow.
EDCS-24501900.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Napia, erected by her father Honori.

EDCS-24501904.translation: To the public funds of the municipality of Sufetula, from Marcus Publius Aelius Macrinus.
EDCS-24501904.summary: This inscription records a financial contribution to the municipality of Sufetula by Marcus Publius Aelius Macrinus.

EDCS-24501906.translation: Public property of the municipality of the Sufetulenses, from the Musunii. Marcus Junius Rufinus Sabinianus, most distinguished man.
EDCS-24501906.summary: This inscription records a public work funded by the Musunii for the municipality of Sufetulenses, mentioning Marcus Junius Rufinus Sabinianus as a distinguished man.

EDCS-24501908.translation: Public property of the municipality of the Sufetulenses, from the Musunii. Marcus Junius Rufinus Sabinianus, most distinguished man.
EDCS-24501908.summary: This inscription records a public work funded by the Musunii for the municipality of Sufetulenses, mentioning the distinguished man Marcus Junius Rufinus Sabinianus (with a partial restoration).

EDCS-24501910.translation: The town council, with money collected, made and dedicated this monument to Gaius Turranius Silvanus, son of Gaius, of the Quirina tribe, as *flamen Augusti*, quaestor of the treasury, prefect of justice, and twice chief magistrate, because of his outstanding straightforwardness and his innocence towards all during his term as chief magistrate, in order to declare and attest their sense of duty and affection.
EDCS-24501910.summary: This is a public dedication by the curia to a former magistrate named Gaius Turranius Silvanus, praising his integrity.

EDCS-24501911.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Domitia Prima, daughter of Gaius, dutiful, lived 60 years, is buried here.
EDCS-24501911.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Domitia Prima, recording her age and burial place.

EDCS-24501913.translation: To the spirits of the departed. Honorata Fortunata lived [approximate age] years.
EDCS-24501913.summary: This is a fragmentary funerary epitaph for Honorata Fortunata, likely recording her name and lifespan.

EDCS-24501914.translation: Pompeianus, a loyal soldier and commander, lived in peace for 68 years and was buried on the second day before the Kalends of March in the thirteenth indiction.
EDCS-24501914.summary: This epitaph records the death and burial of Pompeianus, a military leader, in the Byzantine era.

EDCS-24501915.translation: Biola, a faithful woman, lived for twenty years and was buried on the sixteenth day before the Kalends of June in the seventh indiction.
EDCS-24501915.summary: This epitaph records the death of Biola, who lived for twenty years, during the Byzantine era.

EDCS-24501918.translation: Her parents dedicated this small altar as a memorial of sorrow; she lived for 13 years.
EDCS-24501918.summary: This epitaph records the death of a young girl, with her parents dedicating a memorial altar.

EDCS-24501919.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Cecilia Victoria, daughter of Marcus, lived for 70 years.
EDCS-24501919.summary: This is a tombstone for Cecilia Victoria, recording her name and age.

EDCS-24501921.translation: He lived 10 years and 6 months. Titus Flavius Victor made this for his most devoted son.
EDCS-24501921.summary: This epitaph records the death of a young boy, made by his father Titus Flavius Victor.

EDCS-24501922.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Departed. Laetoria Tertia, who was killed, lived for 32 years. Titus Flavius Victor made this for his dearest wife.
EDCS-24501922.summary: This epitaph records the death of Laetoria Tertia, who was killed, made by her husband Titus Flavius Victor.

EDCS-24501926.translation: To Rogata, wife of Luciscius, his most faithful wife, lived 60 years.
EDCS-24501926.summary: This epitaph records the death of Rogata, wife of Luciscius, noting her age and fidelity.

EDCS-24501927.translation: Abundantius, son of Mithinus, lived 16 years, minus 5 hours.
EDCS-24501927.summary: This epitaph records the death of Abundantius, son of Mithinus, noting his age with unusual precision.

EDCS-24501928.translation: Lucidus, son of Mithimus, lived 11 months and 9 days.
EDCS-24501928.summary: This epitaph records the death of a very young child, Lucidus, son of Mithimus.

EDCS-24501929.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Gaius Staberius Primus made this for his dutiful wife Caia Staberia. Sacred to the departed spirits. Gaius Staberius Primus the Younger lived 15 years, for his dutifulness. Sacred to the departed spirits. Lucius Salonius lived [X] years. Sacred to the departed spirits. Gaius Staberius Quitus lived 35 years, for his dutifulness.
EDCS-24501929.summary: This funerary inscription records the death and dedication of several individuals, including Gaius Staberius Primus and his wife, and possibly their son or another family member, with lengths of life given for some and emphasis on pietas for others.

EDCS-24501930.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. I, Staberius Primus, lived 70 years. Staberia Casta, his wife, lived [X] years. Flavius Staberius Fuscius lived 48 years. Plotia Paula, his aunt, lived 3 years. Staberia Beric made and dedicated this.
EDCS-24501930.summary: This funerary inscription records the deaths of Staberius Primus, his wife Staberia Casta, their son Flavius Staberius Fuscius, and his aunt Staberia Beric, with specified ages at death and Staberia Beric as the dedicator.

EDCS-24501931.translation: From Victorianus's workshop, Alumnius from Thamar volunteered to build a small shrine.
EDCS-24501931.summary: This inscription records a volunteer construction of a shrine by Alumnius from Thamar, originating from the workshop of Victorianus.

EDCS-24501932.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Publius Aurelius Felicianus is buried here. He lived 17 years and 8 months. His parents made this for their learned and most dutiful son.
EDCS-24501932.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Publius Aurelius Felicianus, who died at age 17 years and 8 months, erected by his parents.

EDCS-24501933.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Aurelius Fortunatus is buried here. He lived dutifully for 30 years. His son, Quintus Aurelius Saturninus, placed this. He lived 68 years.
EDCS-24501933.summary: This funerary inscription records the death of Aurelius Fortunatus at age 30, who was dutiful, and his son Quintus Aurelius Saturninus, who placed the inscription and lived to 68.

EDCS-24501935.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Arnesia Maxima, dutiful, lived 5 years.
EDCS-24501935.summary: This is a brief funerary inscription for a young girl named Arnesia Maxima who died at the age of 5.

EDCS-24501937.translation: Sentia lived 55 years, more or less, and rested in peace.
EDCS-24501937.summary: This is a simple funerary epitaph stating the name of the deceased, Sentia, her approximate age at death, and a wish for peace.

EDCS-24501939.text_edition: \n Caius Iulius Cai filius Galeria Lugduno Mansuetus miles legionis III Augustae centuria Veti vixit annis XXXIIX militavit annis XIIX hic situs est Caius Iulius PVIVS \n
EDCS-24501939.translation: Gaius Julius Mansuetus, son of Gaius, of the Galeria tribe, from Lugduno, soldier of the Third Augustan Legion, under Centurion Vetus, lived 38 years, served 18 years, is buried here. Gaius Julius PVIVS.
EDCS-24501939.summary: This is a soldier's tombstone for Gaius Julius Mansuetus, detailing his military service, age, and burial, with an additional name.

EDCS-24501940.translation: Quintus Domitius Fuscinus, son of Quintus, from the Stellatina tribe, from Foro Vibi, a soldier of the 15th cohort, served 7 years, lived [X] years.
EDCS-24501940.summary: This inscription records the life and military service of Quintus Domitius Fuscinus, a soldier who served for 7 years.

EDCS-24501941.translation: Marcus Iunius Maritumus, son of Marcus, of the Pomponi centuria, Galeria tribe, from Luguduno, a soldier of the 3rd Augustan legion, lived 20 years, served 4 years, [---]
EDCS-24501941.summary: This funerary inscription records the life and military service of Marcus Iunius Maritumus, a soldier of the 3rd Augustan legion who died at age 20 after serving for 4 years.

EDCS-24501942.translation: Quintus Lucretius Aper, son of Marcus, of the Falerna tribe, a soldier of the 3rd Augustan legion.
EDCS-24501942.summary: This inscription identifies Quintus Lucretius Aper, son of Marcus, from the Falerna tribe, as a soldier in the 3rd Augustan legion.

EDCS-24501943.translation: Marcus, a soldier of the 15th cohort, served for 9 years and lived for 27 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-24501943.summary: This is a soldier's tombstone recording his military service and age at death.

EDCS-24501944.translation: A veteran from Utica of the 3rd Augustan Legion, he lived for 62 years and served for 32 years; his sons erected this out of filial piety. He is buried here.
EDCS-24501944.summary: This tombstone records the life and service of a veteran of the 3rd Augustan Legion, erected by his sons.

EDCS-24501945.translation: Lucius Audius Secundus set this up according to his will. May the earth lie lightly on you.
EDCS-24501945.summary: A funerary dedication set up by Lucius Audius Secundus in accordance with his will.

EDCS-24501946.translation: A cavalryman from the 1st Pannonian Wing, [serving in] the same unit, from his own...
EDCS-24501946.summary: This fragmentary inscription likely refers to a cavalryman from the 1st Pannonian Wing.

EDCS-24501948.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Julius Datus lived for 40 years; the curiales erected this out of piety. He is buried here.
EDCS-24501948.summary: A tombstone for Julius Datus, erected by the curiales out of piety.

EDCS-24501949.translation: Slave from the household of Gnaeus Domitius Tullus, legate of the Emperor. He is buried here. Pompeius Stephanus saw to it.
EDCS-24501949.summary: A tombstone for a household slave of the imperial legate Gnaeus Domitius Tullus, arranged by Pompeius Stephanus.

EDCS-24501950.text_edition: \n Epithymetus Sergia Corneli Cethegi proconsulis servus hic situs est vixit nnos X\n
EDCS-24501950.translation: Epithymetus, slave of Sergia Cornelia Cethega, proconsul's wife, is buried here. Lived 10 years.
EDCS-24501950.summary: This is a funerary epitaph for Epithymetus, a slave, recording his age and owner.

EDCS-24501951.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Aemilia Restutula lived for 21 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-24501951.summary: A tombstone recording the death of Aemilia Restutula at the age of 21.

EDCS-24501952.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Calpodus the dutiful lived for 12 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-24501952.summary: A tombstone for Calpodus, who died at the age of 12.

EDCS-24501953.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Cammurena Casta, worthy, to her dearest husband. Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Quintus Vinius Magnius Dignus lived for 50 years and 8 months; he is buried here.
EDCS-24501953.summary: A double tombstone recording the deaths of Cammurena Casta and her husband Quintus Vinius Magnius Dignus.

EDCS-24501954.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Cluvus lived for 36 years. Arin S...
EDCS-24501954.summary: A fragmentary tombstone for Cluvus, who died at the age of 36.

EDCS-24501955.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Cornelia Victorina lived 5 years; her devoted paternal grandfather, Cornelius Ianuarius, made this tomb for her out of piety. Sacred to the departed spirits. Cornelia Fortunata lived 52 years; she made this tomb for herself. Sacred to the departed spirits. Iulia Victorina lived 81 years; Cornelius Ianuarius made these tombs for her mother and father. Sacred to the departed spirits. Titus Cornelius Secundus lived 57 years.
EDCS-24501955.summary: This inscription records the burials of several individuals, including Cornelia Victorina, Cornelia Fortunata, Iulia Victorina, and Titus Cornelius Secundus, with one tomb made by a grandfather for his granddaughter.

EDCS-24501956.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Ianuarius made this for his sons, Numisatrus who lived 9 years, and his son.
EDCS-24501956.summary: This inscription records a father, Ianuarius, dedicating a tomb for his son Numisatrus, who died at the age of nine.

EDCS-24501957.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Publius Geminius Peguarianus lived 66 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-24501957.summary: This is a tombstone inscription for Publius Geminius Peguarianus, recording his age at death as 66.

EDCS-24501958.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Marcus Marius Rusticus lived 20 years; Iunia Saturnina placed this for her devoted son; he is buried here. Sacred to the departed spirits. Marcus Marius Malchio lived 50 years; Iunia Saturnina placed this for her devoted husband; he is buried here.
EDCS-24501958.summary: This inscription records the burials of Marcus Marius Rusticus, honored by his mother Iunia Saturnina, and Marcus Marius Malchio, honored by his wife Iunia Saturnina.

EDCS-24501959.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Quintus Maximus, devoted, lived 52 years and 5 months; he is buried here. Iulia Siolis placed this for her devoted husband.
EDCS-24501959.summary: This tombstone records the death of Quintus Maximus at age 52 years and 5 months, dedicated by his wife Iulia Siolis.

EDCS-24501960.translation: Petronius Gallianus, who is also called Harpaxius, lived 45 years, is buried here. Pompeia Maxima placed this for her devoted husband.
EDCS-24501960.summary: This funerary epitaph records the life and burial of Petronius Gallianus, erected by his wife Pompeia Maxima.

EDCS-24501961.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Primitivus lived 65 years; he is buried here. Mercurialis placed this for his father.
EDCS-24501961.summary: This is a tombstone inscription for Primitivus, who lived 65 years, dedicated by his son Mercurialis.

EDCS-24501962.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Seculus lived 11 years; Calentes placed this for his son; he is buried here.
EDCS-24501962.summary: This inscription records the burial of Seculus, who died at the age of 11, dedicated by his father Calentes.

EDCS-24501963.summary: This is a simple tombstone inscription recording the name and age at death of Secudianus.

EDCS-24501964.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Tailta lived 27 years; her devoted mother placed this for her son; he is buried here.
EDCS-24501964.summary: This tombstone records the death of Tailta at age 27, dedicated by his devoted mother.

EDCS-24501966.translation: Sacred to Caelestis Augusta. Publius Geminius Martialis, in the year of his priesthood, made a colonnaded portico with seven steps at his own expense, under the care of Lucius Flavius Salvianus.
EDCS-24501966.summary: This inscription records a public works dedication by Publius Geminius Martialis, who funded a portico with steps during his priesthood.

EDCS-24501967.translation: Sacred to Pluto Augustus. Fortunatus gladly placed a gate with a willing heart.
EDCS-24501967.summary: This is a dedication of a gate to Pluto Augustus by Fortunatus.

EDCS-24501968.translation: Sacred to Saturn Augustus, the god Lord Saturn. By order of the priests, they made and dedicated it for the space which Tatti Rogatianus donated.
EDCS-24501968.summary: This inscription records the dedication of a space to Saturn Augustus by priests, at the behest of Tatti Rogatianus.

EDCS-24501969.translation: Sacred to Saturn Augustus. Lucius Postumius made a *baetulum* with a column at his own expense.
EDCS-24501969.summary: Lucius Postumius dedicated a *baetulum* with a column to Saturn Augustus.

EDCS-24501970.translation: Sacred to Saturn Augustus. Marcus Egrinius [---]
EDCS-24501970.summary: This is a partial inscription mentioning Marcus Egrinius in relation to Saturn Augustus.

EDCS-24501971.translation: Of Saturn Augustus, of Extricatus, son of Nabor.
EDCS-24501971.summary: This is a fragment likely related to Saturn Augustus and a person named Extricatus.

EDCS-24501972.translation: Sacred to Saturn Augustus. Publius Postumius Proculus made an altar at his own expense during his priesthood.
EDCS-24501972.summary: Publius Postumius Proculus dedicated an altar to Saturn Augustus, funded by himself during his term as priest.

EDCS-24501974.translation: Quintus Fulvius Victorianus erected a statue at his own expense.
EDCS-24501974.summary: Quintus Fulvius Victorianus erected a statue at his own expense.

EDCS-24501977.text_edition: \n AES Impperatoribus ddominis nnostris Diocletiano III et Maximiano II conssulibus hheredes Sulpicii Felicis istut sic opus plateae quam Felix pater eques Romanus ob aedilitatis suae honorem promisit civitati nostrae cum gradibus III propriis sumptibus perfecerunt per Sulpicium Primum tutorem\n
EDCS-24501977.translation: For the safety of our lords the Emperors Diocletian Augustus for the third time and Maximian Augustus for the second time, consuls. The heirs of Sulpicius Felix completed this work on the street, which Felix, his father, a Roman knight, promised for the honor of his aedilship, for our city, with three flights of steps, at their own expense, under the guardianship of Sulpicius Primus.
EDCS-24501977.summary: This inscription records the completion of a public works project, a street with steps, funded by the heirs of Sulpicius Felix in honor of his aedilship, during the consulship of Diocletian and Maximian.

EDCS-24501980.translation: Lucius Marcius Pollia, son of Lucius, from Ostra, lived 60 years, served 30 years in the military, fell in battle. Lucius Marcius Dius erected [this monument].
EDCS-24501980.summary: This is a funerary monument for Lucius Marcius Pollia, erected by Lucius Marcius Dius, detailing his life and military service.

EDCS-24501981.translation: Cnaeus Terentius Rufus, son of Cnaeus, of the Clustumina tribe, from Iguvium, a soldier in the Third Augustan Legion, lived 35 years. His heirs erected this monument in his honor.
EDCS-24501981.summary: This is a funerary monument for Cnaeus Terentius Rufus, erected by his heirs, stating his military service and age at death.

EDCS-24501982.translation: Sacred to the Spirits of the Dead. Quintus Aberrinius Proculus lived 90 years.
EDCS-24501982.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Quintus Aberrinius Proculus, commemorating his long life.

EDCS-24501983.translation: Sacred to the Divine Spirits. Gaius Baebius Rogatus lived for 7 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-24501983.summary: This funerary inscription records the burial of Gaius Baebius Rogatus, who died at the age of 7.

EDCS-24501984.translation: Lucius Bibultrius Felix lived for 85 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-24501984.summary: This funerary inscription records the burial of Lucius Bibultrius Felix, who died at the age of 85.

EDCS-24501985.translation: Sacred to the Divine Spirits. Lucius C. Novelus lived for 80 years.
EDCS-24501985.summary: This funerary inscription records that Lucius C. Novelus lived for 80 years.

EDCS-24501986.translation: Calpurnia Honorata, dutiful, lived for 65 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-24501986.summary: This funerary inscription records the burial of Calpurnia Honorata, who died at the age of 65.

EDCS-24501987.translation: Sacred to the Divine Spirits. Lucius Carmeius Roggatus lived for 50 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-24501987.summary: This funerary inscription records the burial of Lucius Carmeius Roggatus, who died at the age of 50.

EDCS-24501988.translation: Sacred to the Divine Spirits. Gaius Cluvius Felix, dutiful, lived for 33 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-24501988.summary: This funerary inscription records the burial of Gaius Cluvius Felix, who died at the age of 33.

EDCS-24501989.translation: Sacred to the Divine Spirits. Quintus Considius lived for 41 years.
EDCS-24501989.summary: This funerary inscription records that Quintus Considius lived for 41 years.

EDCS-24501990.translation: Sacred to the Divine Spirits. ...us and Faba.
EDCS-24501990.summary: This fragmentary funerary inscription mentions the names 'us' and Faba, possibly indicating a burial or dedication.

EDCS-24501991.translation: Sacred to the Divine Spirits. Faonia Fortunata.
EDCS-24501991.summary: This funerary inscription is a dedication to the Divine Spirits for Faonia Fortunata.

EDCS-24501992.translation: ...ga Fortunata, daughter of Publius, lived for 40 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-24501992.summary: This funerary inscription records the burial of Fortunata, daughter of Publius, who died at the age of 40.

EDCS-24501993.translation: To the spirits of the departed. Fulvia Quinta lived 40 years and is buried here.
EDCS-24501993.summary: A funerary epitaph for Fulvia Quinta, who lived 40 years.

EDCS-24501994.translation: Gaius Licinius Geminus, son of Marcus, of the tribe Stellina, lived 111 years and is buried here.
EDCS-24501994.summary: A funerary epitaph for Gaius Licinius Geminus, who lived 111 years.

EDCS-24501995.summary: A funerary epitaph for Licinia [---], who lived 103 years.

EDCS-24501996.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Lucretia Pa[---]
EDCS-24501996.summary: A funerary inscription, likely incomplete, dedicated to the spirits of the departed for Lucretia Pa[---].

EDCS-24501997.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Quintus, son of Marcus, lived 27 years and is buried here.
EDCS-24501997.summary: A funerary epitaph for Quintus, son of Marcus, who lived 27 years.

EDCS-24501998.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Pius lived 70 years. Mamonius Getulicus is buried here.
EDCS-24501998.summary: A funerary epitaph for Pius and Mamonius Getulicus, recording their ages or lifespans.

EDCS-24501999.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Marius Fortunius lived 29 years.
EDCS-24501999.summary: A funerary epitaph for Marius Fortunius, who lived 29 years.

EDCS-24502000.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Petronius Tiro lived. Sacred to the spirits of the departed.
EDCS-24502000.summary: A funerary inscription for Petronius Tiro, possibly recording his death or placement.

EDCS-24502001.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the departed. Postumia Maurica, the pious one, lived 35 years.
EDCS-24502001.summary: A funerary epitaph for Postumia Maurica, noting her piety and lifespan of 35 years.

EDCS-24502002.translation: Quinta, daughter of Mutunis, the pious one, lived 32 years and is buried here.
EDCS-24502002.summary: A funerary epitaph for Quinta Mutunis, who lived 32 years and was pious.

EDCS-24502003.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Sexta Rufina lived 92 years.
EDCS-24502003.summary: This is a tombstone inscription commemorating Sexta Rufina, who lived for 92 years.

EDCS-24502004.summary: This tombstone inscription records the short life of Saturnina, who died at age 13.

EDCS-24502005.translation: Selcat, daughter of Balenis, lived 21 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-24502005.summary: This tombstone inscription commemorates Selcat, daughter of Balenis, who died at age 21 and is buried here.

EDCS-24502006.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Publius Titinius Dexter lived 25 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-24502006.summary: This tombstone inscription commemorates Publius Titinius Dexter, who died at age 25 and is buried here.

EDCS-24502007.translation: Quintus Valerius Optatus lived 45 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-24502007.summary: This tombstone inscription commemorates Quintus Valerius Optatus, who died at age 45 and is buried here.

EDCS-24502008.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Valeria Restuta lived 90 years.
EDCS-24502008.summary: This tombstone inscription commemorates Valeria Restuta, who lived for 90 years.

EDCS-24502009.translation: Felix Zanccarius with his family fulfilled a vow.
EDCS-24502009.summary: This inscription records Felix Zanccarius fulfilling a votive offering with his family.

EDCS-24502011.translation: I, Bicemalos the deacon, made this in memory of the saintly Iulianus.
EDCS-24502011.summary: This inscription records Bicemalos, a deacon, erecting a memorial for Saint Iulianus.

EDCS-24502012.text_edition: \n Pro salutem sic domini nostri cultores Iovis Optimi Maximi paganicum suum sua pecunia fecerunt magistri ATVCI \n
EDCS-24502012.translation: For the well-being of our lord, the worshippers of Jupiter Optimus Maximus made their pagan festival at their own expense, the magistrates ATVCI.
EDCS-24502012.summary: This inscription records a religious festival funded by the magistrates ATVCI for the well-being of their lord and in honor of Jupiter Optimus Maximus.

EDCS-24502013.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Lucius Aufidius Restutus the pious lived 70 years; Aufidia Lucilla Aufidiana placed this here for her dearest father.
EDCS-24502013.summary: This tombstone inscription commemorates Lucius Aufidius Restutus, who lived 70 years, and was erected by his daughter Aufidia Lucilla Aufidiana.

EDCS-24502014.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Clodius Fortunatus lived 85 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-24502014.summary: This tombstone inscription commemorates Clodius Fortunatus, who died at age 85 and is buried here.

EDCS-24502015.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. Iulia Ianuaria lived for [number] years; she made this for herself while she was alive.
EDCS-24502015.summary: This funerary epitaph records the death of Iulia Ianuaria, who made her own tombstone during her lifetime.

EDCS-24502016.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. [Name/description] lived for 10 years. Curanius [made this?]. LVI
EDCS-24502016.summary: This funerary epitaph records the death of an individual who lived 10 years, with a possible mention of Curanius.

EDCS-24502017.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. Viator Lucius Iulius lived for 25 years.
EDCS-24502017.summary: This funerary epitaph records the death of Viator Lucius Iulius, who lived for 25 years.

EDCS-24502018.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. [Name] lived for 130 years; here he is laid.
EDCS-24502018.summary: This funerary epitaph records the death of an individual who lived for 130 years.

EDCS-24502019.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. Ulpia Secunda, priestess, lived for 85 years; she made this for herself while she was alive.
EDCS-24502019.summary: This funerary epitaph records the death of Ulpia Secunda, a priestess, who made her own tombstone during her lifetime.

EDCS-24502020.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. Veneriosa, pious daughter of Publius Sentius, lived for 25 years; here she is laid. Sentia Septricata [made this?].
EDCS-24502020.summary: This funerary epitaph records the death of Veneriosa, daughter of Publius Sentius, who lived for 25 years.

EDCS-24502021.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. Caecilia Saesula lived for 7 years, 6 months, and 15 days; here she is laid. Caecilius Martialis placed [this].
EDCS-24502021.summary: This funerary epitaph records the death of Caecilia Saesula, who lived for 7 years, 6 months, and 15 days, and was placed here by Caecilius Martialis.

EDCS-24502022.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. Publius Aelius Montanus lived for 85 years; here he is laid.
EDCS-24502022.summary: This funerary epitaph records the death of Publius Aelius Montanus, who lived for 85 years.

EDCS-24502023.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. Flavia Victoria. Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. Quintus Octavius Victor lived for 4 years; here he is laid. Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. Quintus Octavius Criscis lived for 70 years.
EDCS-24502023.summary: This funerary epitaph records the deaths of Quintus Octavius Victor (aged 4) and Quintus Octavius Criscis (aged 70), and also mentions Flavia Victoria.

EDCS-24502024.translation: Sacred to the spirits of the underworld. Caius Felix Rogatianus lived for 50 years; here he is.
EDCS-24502024.summary: This funerary epitaph records the death of Caius Felix Rogatianus, who lived for 50 years.

EDCS-24502025.translation: Gaius, son of Quintus, a dutiful son, lived for 6 years.
EDCS-24502025.summary: This is a funerary inscription for a child named Gaius, recording his age at death.

EDCS-24502026.summary: This is a funerary inscription for a person named Tertius, recording his age at death.

EDCS-24502027.translation: Cascellia, dutiful daughter of Spurius, lived for 30 years and is buried here.
EDCS-24502027.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Cascellia, recording her age and burial.

EDCS-24502028.translation: Lucius Junius Ianuarius fulfilled his vow to the lord and god Neptune, and to the gods and goddesses and their divine powers.
EDCS-24502028.summary: This is a votive inscription from Lucius Junius Ianuarius to Neptune and other deities.

EDCS-24502029.summary: This is a simple funerary inscription for Benenata, possibly from the early Christian period.

EDCS-24502030.translation: To the departed spirits: Gaius Flavius Felix Postuminus lived for 43 years and is buried here.
EDCS-24502030.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Gaius Flavius Felix Postuminus, recording his age and burial.

EDCS-24502031.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits: Tarautius lived for 41 years, 9 months, 8 days, and 6 hours, and is buried here.
EDCS-24502031.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Tarautius, recording his age and burial with unusual precision.

EDCS-24502033.translation: Hail, Flaviane! Sacred to the departed spirits. In life, seven lived for 65 years. She is buried here. To the departed spirits. Mai. Inu. mi.
EDCS-24502033.summary: This is a complex funerary inscription possibly for a woman named Flaviane, mentioning multiple individuals and their lifespan.

EDCS-24502034.translation: Saturninus, dutiful son of Rogatus, is buried here.
EDCS-24502034.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Saturninus, recording his parentage and burial.

EDCS-24502035.translation: Sacred to Neptune Augustus: Marcus Licinius Quintianus with his family paid his vow.
EDCS-24502035.summary: This is a votive inscription from Marcus Licinius Quintianus and his family to Neptune Augustus.

EDCS-24502036.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Ulpius Felix Frontonianus lived for 7 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-24502036.summary: This is a funerary inscription for a boy named Ulpius Felix Frontonianus, who died at the age of seven.

EDCS-24502037.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Caius Clodius [son of] Diovinus [and] Octavia lived for 3 years [and] 2 years.
EDCS-24502037.summary: This is a funerary inscription for two children, likely siblings, named Caius Clodius and Octavia, whose ages are given.

EDCS-24502039.translation: To Missiva, my daughter, [who] lived for 25 years; she is buried here.
EDCS-24502039.summary: This is a funerary inscription for a daughter named Missiva, who died at the age of twenty-five.

EDCS-24502042.translation: To Chinanipis, son of IIVni, from Miditanum.
EDCS-24502042.summary: This is an inscription honoring Chinanipis, son of IIVni, who was from Miditanum.

EDCS-24502043.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Aurelius.
EDCS-24502043.summary: This is a fragmentary funerary inscription, mentioning Aurelius.

EDCS-24502044.translation: Aurelius Namfamo lived for 10 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-24502044.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Aurelius Namfamo, who died at the age of ten.

EDCS-24502045.translation: [---]s Castus lived for 25 years; he is buried here.
EDCS-24502045.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Castus, who died at the age of twenty-five.

EDCS-24502046.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Tiberius Claudius Optatus lived for 51 years.
EDCS-24502046.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Tiberius Claudius Optatus, who died at the age of sixty-one.

EDCS-24502047.summary: This is a fragmentary inscription identifying Crescens as the son of someone whose name is partially preserved.

EDCS-24502048.translation: Sacred to the departed spirits. Domitius Saturninus lived for 70 years.
EDCS-24502048.summary: This is a funerary inscription for Domitius Saturninus, who died at the age of seventy.

EDCS-24502049.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Donatus.
EDCS-24502049.summary: A funerary dedication by Donatus to the Divine Shades, likely for himself or a relative.

EDCS-24502050.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Eipicius.
EDCS-24502050.summary: A funerary dedication by Eipicius to the Divine Shades, likely for himself or a relative.

EDCS-24502051.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Edinia Rogata, daughter of Amozcuaris, lived 40 years. Sacred to the Divine Shades. Lucius Ef Firmullus lived 51 years.
EDCS-24502051.summary: A double funerary inscription recording the lives and deaths of Edinia Rogata and Lucius Ef Firmullus.

EDCS-24502052.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. Lucius Efficius Mazacus lived 44 years. Sacred to the Divine Shades. Ar Au 40 [years?].
EDCS-24502052.summary: A funerary inscription recording the life of Lucius Efficius Mazacus and a partial record of another individual.

EDCS-24502053.translation: Sacred to the Divine Shades. F Caste.
EDCS-24502053.summary: A funerary dedication by F. Caste to the Divine Shades, likely for himself or a relative.
